ga: Mɛni hewɔ mishikpɔŋ lɛ woɔ niyenii fioo daa be mli kɛji midu ŋmãa yɛ he kome lɛ?

english: Planting the same crop repeatedly draws the exact same nutrients from the soil until the ground becomes exhausted. Rotating maize with crops like cowpeas or groundnuts helps put vital nutrients back into the soil naturally.
ga: Tso kome too lɛ nɔŋŋ ni aduɔ shii abɔ Egbalaa niyenii mli hewalɛ kome too lɛ nɔŋŋ kɛjɛɔ sũ lɛ mli kɛyashiɔ be mli ni sũ lɛ mli shwieɔ shi. Abɛi ni akɛ ŋmɔshi nibii tamɔ tsina loo ŋmei tsakeɔ Eyeɔ ebuaa ni ekɛ niyenii ni he hiaa baa shikpɔŋ lɛ mli ekoŋŋ yɛ adebɔɔ naa.

english: This damage is usually caused by Fall Armyworm caterpillars, which crawl into the funnel of the plant to feed on tender young leaves before they fully unfold.
ga: Bei pii lɛ, Fall Armyworm ŋmeii ni shwieɔ tsei lɛ amli koni amɛye tsei lɛ ahe baai bibii lɛ dani amɛgbeleɔ amɛhe kwraa lɛ ji mɛi ni kɛ nɛkɛ fitemɔ nɛɛ baa.

english: Why are the leaves of my tomato plants curling up tightly and stopping fruit growth?
ga: Mɛni hewɔ mi tomato baai lɛ ebɔle ehe waa ni ekpaa aduawai lɛ adalɛ?

english: Leaf curl is often caused by a virus spread by tiny whitefly insects. When infected, the plant cannot process sunlight properly, causing stunted leaves and preventing fruits from growing big.
ga: Bei pii lɛ, hela ko ni ŋmeii bibii yɛŋ gbɛɔ eshwaa lɛ ji nɔ ni kɛ baai ni shwieɔ shi lɛ baa. Beni hela lɛ emɔ Tsei lɛ nyɛŋ aná hulu la jogbaŋŋ. Enɛ haa baai lɛ shwieɔ shi ni aduawai lɛ hu shwereɔ.

english: When mature cassava tubers sit in waterlogged soil, air cannot reach them. Excess standing water suffocates the tubers under the ground, causing them to decay rapidly.
ga: Kɛ́ ŋmei shishifãi lɛ dara kwraa lɛ, amɛtaraa shikpɔŋ ni nu eyi mli obɔ lɛ nɔ. Kɔɔyɔɔ nyɛŋ ashɛ ŋmei shishifãi lɛ ahe. Nu ni damɔ shi babaoo lɛ baaha ŋmeii lɛ agbɔjɔ. Nɔ ni jɛɔ mli baa ji akɛ, amɛfiteɔ oya.

english: Yam leaves need to reach as much sunlight as possible. Staking lifts the leaves high into the light, allowing the plant to generate energy to swell the tubers beneath the ground.
ga: Hulu la he miihia sweet potato baai lɛ babaoo bɔ ni aaanyɛ. Staking baaha baai lɛ aya ŋwɛi shɔɔŋ kɛya la lɛ mli. Enɛ haa tso lɛ feɔ hewalɛ ni haa ŋmeii lɛ shwereɔ.

english: Why do my crop plants produce smaller yields when I plant seeds very close to each other?
ga: Mɛni hewɔ miŋmɔshi nibii lɛ wooo yibii fioo kɛ́ midu dumɔwui ni bɛŋkɛ amɛhe waa lɛ?

english: When crops are planted too closely, they compete with one another for soil nutrients, groundwater, and light, leaving every individual plant weak and undernourished.
ga: Kɛji adu tsei ni bɛŋkɛ amɛhe tsɔ Tsei kɛ amɛhe woɔ niyenii ni haa mɔ hewalɛ ni yɔɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ mli, shikpɔŋ shishi nu kɛ la mli lɛ he akaŋ, ni no haa tsei fɛɛ gbɔjɔɔ ni amɛnáaa niyenii kpakpa.

english: Why do my pepper plants drop their fresh blossoms before any pepper grows?
ga: Mɛni hewɔ mi-pepper tso lɛ miiho fɔfɔi heei dani pepper lɛ kwɛ̃ lɛ?

english: Pepper plants shed their flowers when exposed to sudden temperature spikes or extreme drought stress. The plant drops flowers to save water and energy just to stay alive.
ga: Pepper tsei fɔɔ fɔfɔi kɛji akɛ amɛ kpe trukaa dɔlɛ ni yaa hiɛ loo hɔmɔ ni naa wa. Tsei baashwie amɛfɔfɔi lɛ koni amɛkɛbu nu kɛ hewalɛ he koni amɛhi shi kɛkɛ.

english: During intense afternoon heat, leaves lose water to the air faster than the roots can drink it up. The plant wilts temporarily to reduce surface heat, usually recovering when air temperatures drop at night.
ga: Yɛ shwane mli lɛ, kɔɔyɔɔ lɛ mli edɔɔ waa. Baai lɛ laajeɔ nu kɛyaa kɔɔyɔɔ mli oya fe bɔ ni shishifãi lɛ baanyɛ anu. Tsei lɛ shwieɔ shi yɛ be kukuoo mli koni ekɛba ŋwɛi dɔlɛ shi. Bei pii lɛ, ehiɛ baa shi kɛ́ kɔɔyɔɔ lɛ mli dɔlɛ ba shi gbɛkɛ.

english: Officer, why is it bad to burn all the cleared bush on my field before planting?
ga: Nitsulɔi Mɛni hewɔ eji jwɛŋmɔ gbonyo akɛ mashã jwɛi ni ajie yɛ miŋmɔ lɛ mli lɛ fɛɛ dani adu nii?

english: Burning destroys organic matter and beneficial organisms in the soil. Leaving cleared grass and crop stalks to rot naturally feeds the soil with nutrients and helps keep moisture in the ground.
ga: Shãa fiteɔ nibii ni wala yɔɔ mli kɛ nibii ni he yɔɔ sɛɛnamɔ ni yɔɔ sũ lɛ mli lɛ. Kɛ́ aŋmɛ gbɛ ni jwɛi ni ajie kɛ tsei ahe tsei lɛ fite lɛ, ehaa sũ lɛ mli niyenii ni haa mɔ he jɔɔ lɛ haa sũ lɛ mli nu.

english: Is it safe to plant my maize immediately after the very first rain of the season?
ga: Ani eyɛ shweshweeshwe akɛ aaadu ŋmãa yɛ klɛŋklɛŋ nugbɔ ni nɛ yɛ be lɛ mli lɛ sɛɛ nɔŋŋ?

english: It is safer to wait until the ground gets two or three good rains, because planting after the very first rain can cause seeds to dry up and die if a dry spell follows.
ga: Eyɛ shweshweeshwe akɛ ooomɛ kɛyashi nugbɔ kpakpa anɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ. shii enyɔ loo shii etɛ Enɛ ji akɛ, kɛ́ adu dumɔwui lɛ yɛ klɛŋklɛŋ nugbɔ lɛ sɛɛ lɛ, ebaanyɛ eha dumɔwui lɛ agbi ni amɛgboi kɛji nugbɔshiimɔ be ko nyiɛ sɛɛ.

english: When seeds are planted too close together, the crops fight over sunlight, water, and soil nutrients, resulting in thin stalks and tiny, weak cobs.
ga: Kɛ dumɔwui lɛ bɛŋkɛ amɛhe tsɔ Tsei lɛ wuɔ yɛ hulu la, nu, kɛ niyenii ni yɔɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ mli lɛ he. Enɛ haa tsei bibii kɛ dumɔwui bibii ni bɛ hewalɛ baa.

english: Young cocoa trees burn easily under direct sunlight. Fast-growing plantain trees have large leaves that act as living umbrellas, providing the shade and coolness young cocoa needs to survive.
ga: Cacao tsei bibii lɛ shãa oya yɛ hulu la ni tsoɔ tɛ̃ɛ shishi. Dumɔwui ni daraa oya lɛ yɛ baai agboi ni tsuɔ nii tamɔ ambrela. Ehaa hulutsoo kɛ fɛ̃i ni he hiaa kookoo bibii koni amɛhi shi lɛ haa.

english: How does planting groundnuts or cowpeas make my soil better for the next crop?
ga: Te abaafee tɛŋŋ ni ŋmei loo tsina ŋmei ni aduɔ lɛ aha mishikpɔŋ lɛ aya hiɛ kɛha miŋmɔshi nibii ni nyiɛ sɛɛ lɛ?

english: Legumes like groundnuts capture natural nitrogen from the air and store it in their roots. When the plant dies, that nitrogen stays in the soil as free fertilizer for the next crop.
ga: Legumes tamɔ ŋmeii lɛ diɛŋtsɛ mɔɔ nitrogen kɛjɛɔ kɔɔyɔɔ mli ni amɛkɛtoɔ amɛshishifãi lɛ amli. Kɛ́ tso lɛ gbo lɛ, nakai nitrogen lɛ hiɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ mli akɛ ŋmɔshi nibii ni aheee nɔ ko kɛha ŋmɔshi nibii ni nyiɛ sɛɛ lɛ.

english: Why are the leaves on my cassava dropping off during the dry spell?
ga: Mɛni hewɔ mi-cassava baai lɛ shwieɔ shi yɛ hulutsoo be lɛ mli lɛ?

english: Cassava drops its leaves during dry periods on purpose to save water and stay alive. Once the rains start again, it will quickly sprout fresh green leaves.
ga: Cassava shwieɔ ebaa lɛ yɛ hulutsoo be mli koni ekɛbu nu he ni ehi wala mli. Kɛ nugbɔ bɔi nɛmɔ ekoŋŋ lɛ Baai eŋɔli heei baakwɛ̃ oya.

english: Why do my pepper plants drop all their blossoms before turning into fruits?
ga: Mɛni hewɔ mi-pepper tsei lɛ fɛɛ miifɔ fɔfɔi dani amɛwo yibii lɛ?

english: Pepper plants drop flowers when they suffer from stress like extreme heat, insufficient water, or receiving too much nitrogen fertilizer which makes the plant produce leaves instead of fruit.
ga: Pepper tsei lɛ baashwie amɛfɔfɔi lɛ anɔ kɛji amɛmiipiŋ yɛ haomɔ tamɔ latsaa ni naa wa kɛ nu ni fa bɔ ni sa mli. loo enine shɛ nitrogen ŋmɔshi nibii babaoo nɔ Enɛ haa tso lɛ woɔ baai yɛ aduawai najiaŋ.

english: Why do I need to stick tall wooden poles next to my growing yam plants?
ga: Mɛni hewɔ ehe hiaa ni makɛ tso kakadaŋŋ ama sweet potato tso ko ni miida lɛ masɛi lɛ?

english: Yam vines naturally climb to reach sunlight. Raising the leaves off the damp ground using stakes helps the plant catch more sun, which creates energy to grow larger yam tubers.
ga: Sweet potato wain tsei lɛ kwɔɔ kɛyaa ŋwɛi yɛ amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛhe koni amɛná hulu la. Kɛ́ akɛ tso lɛ wo baai anɔ kɛjɛ hei ni ŋmɔtɔ yɔɔ lɛ, ehaa tso lɛ naa hulu la babaoo. Enɛ baaha hewalɛ aba kɛha sweet potato ŋmeii wuji lɛ akwɛmɔ.

english: How can I tell if caterpillars are attacking the center of my young maize plants?
ga: Te mafee tɛŋŋ male kɛji ŋmeii miitutua mi-baby corn tsei lɛ ateŋgbɛ?

english: If Fall Armyworm caterpillars are present, you will see ragged holes on the leaves and a powdery substance that looks like yellowish sawdust inside the center funnel of the plant.
ga: Kɛji Fall Armyworm ŋmeii lɛ yɛ lɛ, obaana bu ni etse ehe yɛ baai lɛ amli kɛ nɔ ko ni tamɔ powda ni tamɔ ŋmeii ni yɔɔ tso lɛ teŋgbɛ ŋmeii lɛ amli.

english: This rot is caused by a lack of calcium in the fruit, which usually happens when the plant experiences irregular watering while the tomato is growing.
ga: Nɔ ni kɛ nɛkɛ fitemɔ nɛɛ baa ji calcium ni bɛ aduawai lɛ amli lɛ. Bei pii lɛ, enɛ baa mli kɛ́ tso lɛ nine shɛ nu ni kɛ ehe kpaaa gbee nɔ yɛ be mli ni tomatoi lɛ miida lɛ.

english: Young cocoa trees burn easily under direct sunlight. Plantain plants grow quickly and produce large leaves that provide the shade and soil moisture cocoa trees need to survive during their first few years.
ga: Cacao tsei bibii lɛ shãa oya yɛ hulu la ni tsoɔ tɛ̃ɛ shishi. Dumɔwui lɛ daraa oya ni amɛwoɔ baai agboi ni haa hulutsoo kɛ sũ mli nu. Ehe miihia ni cacao tso lɛ ahi shi yɛ eklɛŋklɛŋ afii fioo lɛ amli.

english: Why are the pods on my cocoa trees turning black and rotting on the branch?
ga: Mɛni hewɔ ŋmeii ni yɔɔ mi-cacao tsei lɛ anɔ lɛ miitsɔ ediŋŋ ni amɛmiifite yɛ tsei lɛ aniji lɛ anɔ lɛ?

english: This is black pod disease, which is caused by a fungus that spreads quickly in cool, wet weather. Pruning extra branches to allow sunlight and air into the canopy helps keep the pods dry and stops the fungus.
ga: Enɛ ji black pod hela, ni ŋmei ko ni gbɛɔ eshwaa oya yɛ hei ni mli ejɔ, ni efɔ lɛ kɛbaa. Nibii krokomɛi ni akɛfoɔ tsei lɛ ahe koni hulu la kɛ kɔɔyɔɔ abote tso lɛ mli lɛ yeɔ ebuaa ni ehaa tsei lɛ agbiɔ ni etsiɔ ŋmeii lɛ anaa.

english: Yellowing bottom leaves usually mean the soil lacks nitrogen, which maize needs in large amounts to grow healthy green leaves. Applying nitrogen fertilizer or well-decomposed animal manure will help your maize recover.
ga: Bei pii lɛ, baai lɛ ashishigbɛ ni yɔɔ ŋmɔŋ lɛ tsɔɔ akɛ nitrogen bɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ. Abele babaoo he miihia koni ekwɛ baai eŋɔli ni mli wa. Kɛ́ akɛ nitrogen ŋmɔshi nibii loo kooloo ŋmɔshi nibii ni efite jogbaŋŋ tsu nii lɛ, ebaaye ebua ni ŋmɔshi nibii lɛ aya hiɛ ekoŋŋ.

english: Why shouldn't I plant groundnuts in the exact same farm plot every season?
ga: Mɛni hewɔ esaaa akɛ miduɔ ŋmeii yɛ shikpɔŋ kome nɔ daa afi lɛ?

english: Planting groundnuts repeatedly in the same soil allows pests and leaf spot diseases to multiply in the ground. Rotating groundnuts with crops like maize or cassava breaks disease cycles and keeps your soil healthy.
ga: Nibii ni aduɔ shii abɔ yɛ shikpɔŋ kome nɔ lɛ, ebaaha tsɛŋemɔ helai kɛ baa mli helai babaoo aya shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ. Peanuts kɛ ŋmɔshi nibii tamɔ ŋmãa loo ŋmãa tsakeɔ. Ehaa hela lɛ sɛɛkuu lɛ kpaa ni eyeɔ ebuaa ni oshikpɔŋ lɛ hiɔ shi jogbaŋŋ.

english: Yam plants need sunlight on their leaves to produce food, which is then stored underground to form tubers. Staking lifts the leaves off the damp ground toward the sun, preventing leaf decay and producing bigger yams.
ga: Sweet potato tsei lɛ taoɔ hulu la yɛ amɛbaai lɛ anɔ koni amɛye niyenii. ni no sɛɛ lɛ akɛtoɔ shikpɔŋ shishi koni efee ŋmeii. Staking yeɔ ebuaa ni ewoɔ baai lɛ anɔ kɛjɛɔ hei ni ŋmɔtɔ yɔɔ lɛ kɛyaa hulu la lɛ mli. Etsiɔ baai lɛ anaa koni amɛkafite ni ehaa ŋmeii wuji baa.

english: Can I plant my cassava and maize together on the same piece of land?
ga: Ani manyɛ madu ŋmãa kɛ ŋmãa yɛ shikpɔŋ kome nɔ?

english: Yes, intercropping cassava and maize works well because maize grows quickly and is ready for harvest in a few months, while cassava grows slower and takes over the space later. This allows you to get two food harvests from one plot.
ga: Hɛɛ, ŋmɔshi nibii ni akɛwoɔ ŋmãa kɛ ŋmãa teŋ lɛ tsuɔ nii jogbaŋŋ ejaakɛ ŋmãa lɛ daa oya ni efeɔ klalo kɛha ŋmãa yɛ nyɔji fioo komɛi amli. yɛ be mli ni ŋmei daa blɛoo ni eyeɔ jɛmɛ nɔ yɛ sɛɛ mli. Enɛ haa onine shɛɔ niyenii enyɔ nɔ kɛjɛɔ shikpɔŋ kome nɔ.

english: Why are my tomato plants wilting and dying even when I water them regularly?
ga: Mɛni hewɔ mi-tomato tsei lɛ miigboi ni amɛmiigboi eyɛ mli akɛ mikɛ nu haa amɛ daa moŋ lɛ?

english: This wilting is often caused by soil bacteria or fungi attacking the plant roots, which blocks water from moving up the stem. Extra watering cannot cure it, so it is best to remove sick plants and avoid growing tomatoes in that soil next season.
ga: Bei pii lɛ, muawai ni yɔɔ sũ lɛ mli loo ŋmeii ni tutuaa tsei shishifãi lɛ kɛ nɛkɛ shwiemɔ nɛɛ baa. Enɛ haaa nu lɛ aya ŋwɛi tso lɛ nɔ. Nu ni akɛhaa lɛ babaoo nyɛŋ atsa lɛ. No hewɔ lɛ, ehi jogbaŋŋ akɛ ooojie tsei ni hela mɔ amɛ lɛ, ni otsi ohe kɛjɛ tomato ni ooodu yɛ nakai shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ yɛ be ni baa lɛ mli lɛ he.

english: Why do my pepper plants drop all their blossoms before forming peppers during the hot dry season?
ga: Mɛni hewɔ mi-pepper tso lɛ shwieɔ efɔfɔi lɛ fɛɛ dani ewoɔ pepper yɛ hulutsoo be mli lɛ?

english: Extreme heat and dry air make pepper plants stressed, causing them to shed their flowers to save energy and survive. Providing shade or watering early in the morning helps lower heat stress so peppers can form.
ga: Dɔlɛ ni naa wa kɛ kɔɔyɔɔ ni egbi haoɔ pepper tsei. Nɔ ni jɛɔ mli baa ji akɛ, esa akɛ amɛshwie amɛ fɔfɔi lɛ koni amɛná hewalɛ ni amɛhi shi. Kɛ́ okɛ hulutsoo loo nu ha lɛ leebi lɛ, ebaaha dɔlɛ he haomɔ aba shi bɔni afee ni ŋmeii lɛ anyɛ ama shi.

english: Plant maize seeds about 3 to 5 centimeters deep, which is roughly the length of your thumb tip to the first knuckle. Planting too deep exhausts the seed's energy before reaching sunlight, while planting too shallow leaves seeds open to birds and hot sun.
ga: Dumɔ ŋmãa dumɔwui lɛ mli aaafee sɛntimitai 3 kɛyashi 5, ni ji aaafee ŋmãa lɛ naa kɛyashi klɛŋklɛŋ ŋmãa lɛ he. Kɛ́ adu dumɔwu lɛ mli shɔŋŋ tsɔ lɛ, ebaaha dumɔwu lɛ hewalɛ afite dani hulu la ashɛ enɔ. yɛ be mli ni dumɔwui ni aduɔ yɛ he ko ni mli ekwɔɔɔ tsɔ lɛ baaha okpoi kɛ hulu la ni tsoɔ lɛ aná amɛ gbɛ.

english: Why do weeds harm my young crops so quickly if I delay clearing them?
ga: Mɛni hewɔ jwɛi lɛ tutuaa miŋmɔshi nibii bibii lɛ oya kɛji mikɛ amɛ shwie shi lɛ?

english: Weeds grow much faster than young crops and aggressively steal soil nutrients, water, and sunlight. Clearing weeds early ensures your young crops get all the food and light they need to establish strong roots.
ga: Jwɛi lɛ daa oya fe ŋmɔshi nibii bibii ni ekɛ yiwalɛ juɔ niyenii ni haa mɔ hewalɛ kɛjɛɔ shikpɔŋ, nu kɛ hulu la mli. Jwɛi ni ajieɔ mra Enɛ yeɔ ebuaa ni okwɛɔ koni otsei bibii lɛ aná niyenii kɛ la ni he hiaa amɛ koni amɛná shishifãi ni wa.

english: Why are the lower leaves of my maize plants turning yellow before the crop is even ready for harvest?
ga: Mɛni hewɔ mi-abele tsei lɛ ashishigbɛ baai lɛ feɔ ŋmɔŋ dani tsei lɛ po feɔ klalo kɛha kpamɔ lɛ?

english: Maize leaves turn yellow from the bottom up when the soil runs out of nitrogen, which the plant desperately needs to grow healthy green leaves and big cobs.
ga: Abɛi baai lɛ feɔ ŋmɔŋ kɛjɛɔ shishi kɛyaa ŋwɛi kɛ́ nitrogen bɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ. Tso nɛɛ he miihia babaoo koni ekwɛ baai eŋɔli ni mli wa kɛ ŋmeii wuji.

english: Why do my tomato plants drop their flowers without forming any fruit when it gets very hot?
ga: Mɛni hewɔ mi-tomato tsei lɛ fɔɔ fɔfɔi ni amɛwooo yibii kɛ́ amɛyashɛ hulutsoo be ni naa wa he lɛ?

english: Extreme heat damages the pollen inside tomato flowers, causing the plant to drop its blossoms to save energy instead of producing fruit.
ga: Dɔlɛ ni naa wa waa lɛ fiteɔ ŋmɔtɔ ni yɔɔ tomato fɔfɔi amli lɛ. Ha tomato tsei lɛ agbo koni amɛbu hewalɛ he moŋ fe ni amɛaawo yibii.

english: Why does my pepper plant curl its leaves upwards when the afternoon sun is very bright?
ga: Mɛni hewɔ mi-pepper tsei lɛ shwieɔ amɛbaai lɛ anɔ kɛji shwane hulu lɛ tsoɔ waa lɛ?

english: Pepper plants curl their leaves to shield themselves from harsh sunlight and to slow down the amount of water evaporating from their leaf surfaces.
ga: Pepper tsei lɛ shwieɔ amɛbaai lɛ anɔ koni amɛkɛbu amɛhe kɛjɛ hulu la ni naa wa lɛ he, ni amɛha nu ni hoɔ kɛjɛɔ baa lɛ nɔ lɛ aya hiɛ fioo.

english: Yams bend when the soil is too hard, rocky, or compacted, making it difficult for the tuber to push straight down into the ground as it expands.
ga: Sweet potatoes baafo kɛji shikpɔŋ lɛ mli wa tsɔ, eyɛ tɛi, loo eyɛ ŋmɔlɔŋmɔlɔ, ni no baaha ewa aha ŋmeii lɛ akɛ amɛaatsi amɛhe kɛya shikpɔŋ lɛ mli tɛ̃ɛ. be mli ni egbɛɔ eshwaa lɛ

english: Why do cocoa trees shed so many of their leaves during the dry Harmattan season?
ga: Mɛni hewɔ kookoo tsei lɛ shwieɔ baai babaoo yɛ Harmattan nugbɔshiimɔ be lɛ mli lɛ?

english: Cocoa trees drop leaves in the dry season to reduce water loss, which helps the tree conserve moisture in its trunk to stay alive until the rains return.
ga: Cacao tsei lɛ shwieɔ amɛbaai lɛ yɛ hulutsoo be mli koni nu ni amɛfiteɔ lɛ aba shi. Enɛ baaye abua tso lɛ ni eha ŋmɔtɔ ahi eshishifã lɛ mli kɛyashi nugbɔ baanɛ.

english: Why do my cassava roots rot in the ground when there is too much rain during the wet season?
ga: Mɛni hewɔ mi-cassava shishifãi lɛ fiteɔ yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ mli beni nugbɔ nɛɔ babaoo yɛ nugbɔ be mli lɛ?

english: Cassava roots need air in the soil to breathe, so when heavy rains waterlog the ground for too long, the roots suffocate and begin to decay.
ga: Cassava shishifãi lɛ taoɔ kɔɔyɔɔ yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ mli koni amɛmu. No hewɔ lɛ, kɛ́ nugbɔ nɛ waa lɛ, sũ lɛ kpɛtɛɔ he be kakadaŋŋ tsɔ. Shishifãi lɛ baafo ni amɛbɔi fitemɔ.

english: Why do my cocoa pods turn black and dry up while still hanging on the tree during heavy rains?
ga: Mɛni hewɔ kookoo ŋmeii lɛ feɔ ediŋŋ ni amɛgbiɔ yɛ be mli ni amɛkpɛtɛɔ tsei ahe lolo yɛ nugbɔ ni nɛɔ waa lɛ mli lɛ?

english: Black pod disease is caused by a fungus that spreads quickly in high humidity and wet weather, especially when cool air gets trapped under dense tree branches.
ga: Nɔ ni kɛ black pod hela lɛ baa ji ŋmei ko ni gbɛɔ eshwaa oya yɛ he ni hulutsoo be babaoo kɛ kɔɔyɔɔ ni mli edɔ yɔɔ lɛ. Enɛ ji anɔkwale titri lɛ kɛ́ kɔɔyɔɔ ni mli ejɔ efo tsei aniji ni mli eyi obɔ lɛ amli.

english: How does planting cowpeas or beans on my land help my next maize crop grow better?
ga: Te tsina ŋmãa loo ŋmãa ni aduɔ yɛ mishikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ baanyɛ aye abua mi ŋmãa ni nyiɛ sɛɛ lɛ ni ekwɛ̃ jogbaŋŋ eha tɛŋŋ?

english: Beans and cowpeas take nitrogen gas from the air and store it in the soil, leaving behind natural food that fertilizes the next crop planted in that ground.
ga: Beans kɛ cowpeas jieɔ nitrogen gas kɛjɛɔ kɔɔyɔɔ mli ni amɛkɛtoɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ mli. Enɛ haa adebɔɔ mli niyenii ni akɛbaatsu nii koni akɛwo tso ni nyiɛ sɛɛ ni adu yɛ nakai shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ mli ŋmɔshi nibii.

english: Weeds grow faster than young crops and aggressively steal water, sunlight, and plant food from the soil before your crop gets a chance to use them.
ga: Jwɛi lɛ daa oya fe ŋmɔshi nibii bibii ni amɛkɛ yiwalɛ juɔ nu, hulu la, kɛ niyenii kɛjɛɔ tsei amli dani oŋmɔshi nibii lɛ naa hegbɛ ni amɛkɛtsu nii.

english: Why does my cowpea crop produce plenty of green leaves but very few pods to harvest?
ga: Mɛni hewɔ mi-cowpea tso lɛ yɛ baai eŋɔli babaoo shi ŋmeii fioo pɛ ni esa akɛ akpa lɛ?

english: Cowpeas put all their energy into growing leaves instead of bean pods when the soil has too much nitrogen fertilizer or when they get too much shade.
ga: Cowpeas kɛ amɛhewalɛ fɛɛ tsuɔ nii kɛduɔ baai yɛ pods najiaŋ. Beni shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ nitrogen ŋmɔshi nibii babaoo yɔɔ loo be mli ni hulutsoo be babaoo yɔɔ jɛmɛ.

english: Why do some farmers put coconut husks around the base of crops or burn them on the field?
ga: Mɛni hewɔ okwaafoi komɛi kɛ ŋmei ŋmɔji fɔ̃ɔ amɛŋmɔshi nibii lɛ ashishi loo amɛshãa yɛ ŋmãa ŋmɔji lɛ anɔ lɛ?

english: Coconut husks act like sponges that trap water and keep the soil moist around crop roots during dry periods. Burning them produces biochar, which can help sweeten acidic soils and improve long-term soil structure.
ga: Kokooŋ ŋmeii tsuɔ nii tamɔ sponji, ni ehiɛɔ nu mli ni ehaa shikpɔŋ ni bɔleɔ tsei lɛ ashishifãi ahe lɛ feɔ ŋmɔlɔŋmɔlɔ yɛ nugbɔshiimɔ bei amli. Amɛ ni ashãa lɛ haa biochar baa. Enɛ baanyɛ aye abua ni eha shikpɔŋ ni acid yɔɔ mli lɛ afee fɛo ni eha shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ nibii aya hiɛ yɛ be kakadaŋŋ mli.

english: Why are my coconut trees taking so many years to bear nuts?
ga: Mɛni hewɔ mi ŋmei tso lɛ heɔ afii babaoo dani ewoɔ yibii lɛ?

english: Coconut trees need plenty of sunlight, correct spacing, and rich soil nutrients. If planted too close to each other or shaded by bigger trees, they grow slowly and delay producing nuts.
ga: Hulu la ni fa bɔ ni sa he hiaa ŋmei tsei. sɛɛjɛkɛmɔ ni sa kɛ niyenii mli hewalɛ ni yɔɔ shikpɔŋ ni baa nii amli Kɛji akɛ adu yɛ he ko ni bɛŋkɛ amɛhe tsɔ loo yɛ tso agbo shishi Amɛdaraa blɛoo ni amɛhaa ŋmeii ni anáa lɛ baa shi.

english: Can I plant food crops like maize or cassava underneath my coconut trees?
ga: Mibaanyɛ madu niyenii tamɔ ŋmãa loo ŋmãa. Yɛ ŋmei tso lɛ shishi?

english: Yes, intercropping works well while coconut trees are young because sunlight still reaches the ground. It helps you maximize land space and keeps the soil covered, though you must ensure both crops get enough nutrients.
ga: Hɛɛ, ŋmɔshi nibii ni akɛwoɔ ŋmɔ mli lɛ tsuɔ nii jogbaŋŋ yɛ be mli ni ŋmɔshi tsei lɛ darako lolo lɛ ejaakɛ hulu la lɛ shɛɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lolo. Eyeɔ ebua bo ni ohaa shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ yaa hiɛ ni ehaa shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ shwieɔ shi. Eyɛ mli akɛ ehe miihia ni okwɛ koni tsei enyɔ lɛ fɛɛ aná niyenii ni fa bɔ ni sa moŋ.

english: Is it better to leave some tall trees on my land or clear the whole forest before planting crops?
ga: Ani ehi akɛ mashi tsei kakadaji yɛ mishikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ loo mafo koo muu lɛ fɛɛ mli dani madu?

english: Leaving selected shade trees protects young crops from intense heat, prevents heavy rain from washing away topsoil, and helps keep moisture in the ground during hot seasons.
ga: Kɛ́ ashi tsei lɛ yɛ hulutsoo be mli lɛ, ebaaye ebua ni ebu ŋmɔshi nibii bibii ahe kɛjɛ dɔlɛ ni naa wa waa he. Etsiɔ nugbɔ ni nɛɔ waa lɛ naa koni ekafɔ shikpɔŋ ni yɔɔ ŋwɛi lɛ nɔ. ni eyeɔ ebuaa ni ehaa shikpɔŋ lɛ mli ŋmɔtɔ hiɔ shi yɛ hulutsoo be mli

english: Why do my crops wilt and dry up so fast during intense hot weather?
ga: Mɛni hewɔ miŋmɔshi nibii lɛ shwieɔ shi ni amɛgbiɔ oya yɛ hulutsoo be mli lɛ?

english: Extreme heat causes water to evaporate rapidly from both crop leaves and bare soil. Without ground cover or shade, roots get heat-stressed and cannot pull up water fast enough to keep the plant standing.
ga: Dɔlɛ ni naa wa lɛ haa nu lɛ hoɔ oya kɛjɛɔ tsei ahe baai kɛ shikpɔŋ ni nɔ bɛ nɔ lɛ fɛɛ mli. Kɛji shikpɔŋ loo hulutsoo be bɛ lɛ Shishifãi lɛ feɔ nɔ ni haoɔ kɛjɛɔ latsaa lɛ mli ni amɛnyɛŋ amɛgbala nu oya bɔ ni sa ni baaha tso lɛ adamɔ shi.

english: Does burning bush and farm waste before planting harm my soil over time?
ga: Ani tsei bibii kɛ ŋmɔ mli jwɛi ni ashãa dani aduɔ lɛ baaye mishikpɔŋ lɛ awui yɛ be ni sa mli?

english: While burning clears land quickly and releases a fast boost of ash nutrients, repeated burning destroys beneficial soil organisms and organic matter that keep soil fertile long-term.
ga: yɛ be mli ni la ni ashãa lɛ haa shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ tseɔ oya ni ejieɔ sũ mli niyenii ni haa mɔ hewalɛ oya. shãa ni afɔɔ feemɔ Efiteɔ shikpɔŋ nɔ nibii ni he yɔɔ sɛɛnamɔ kɛ nibii ni haa shikpɔŋ lɛ feɔ ŋmɔshi nii yɛ be kakadaŋŋ mli lɛ.

english: Is ash from burned farm materials enough to feed my crops, or do I need other fertilizers?
ga: Ani sũ ni jɛɔ ŋmɔ mli nibii ni ashã lɛ amli lɛ fa bɔ ni sa ni baaha miŋmɔshi nibii lɛ aná niyenii loo ehe miihia ni makɛ ŋmɔshi nibii krokomɛi atsu nii?

english: Wood ash provides potassium and reduces soil acidity, but it lacks key elements like nitrogen which crops need to build strong green leaves. Relying on ash alone will leave soil deficient over time.
ga: Tso mli sũ haa potassium ni ehaa shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ ŋmɔtɔ baa shi. Shi nibii ni he hiaa tamɔ nitrogen bɛ mli. Enɛ ji nɔ ni he hiaa tsei koni amɛwo baai ni wa ni yɔɔ ŋmɔŋ. Kɛ́ okɛ sũ pɛ tsu nii lɛ, ebaaha shikpɔŋ lɛ afite yɛ be ni sa mli.

english: Why is my farm producing lower yields now compared to years ago using the same traditional methods?
ga: Mɛni hewɔ miŋmɔ lɛ miiwo yibii fioo kɛ akɛto afi ni eho lɛ he kɛtsɔ blema gbɛi ni akɛtsuɔ nii lɛ nɔ lɛ?

english: Over time, continuous farming removes essential nutrients from the soil without replacing them. Changing weather patterns and degraded soil mean older methods need to be supported with modern soil conservation and proper fertilization.
ga: Beni bei hoɔ lɛ Okwaayeli ni yaa nɔ lɛ jieɔ niyenii ni he hiaa kɛjɛɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ mli ni ekɛ nɔ kroko tsakeee. Kɔɔyɔŋ tsakemɔi kɛ shikpɔŋ ni fiteɔ lɛ tsɔɔ akɛ ehe miihia ni akɛ ŋmɛnɛŋmɛnɛ beaŋ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔkwɛmɔ kɛ ŋmɔshi nibii ni sa awo gbɛi momo lɛ asɛɛ.

english: How does covering bare soil with dry leaves or plant husks help my crops grow?
ga: Mɛɛ gbɛ nɔ shikpɔŋ ni nɔ bɛ nɔ ni akɛ baai ni egbi loo tsei ahe tsɔi shwieɔ nɔ lɛ yeɔ ebuaa miŋmɔshi nii lɛ ni amɛdaraa?

english: Covering soil—known as mulching—blocks direct sunlight, reduces water loss, prevents weed seeds from growing easily, and breaks down over time to feed the soil.
ga: Ale mulching hu akɛ mulching. Ebaaye ebua ni etsi hulu la ni tsoɔ tɛ̃ɛ lɛ naa. Ha nu ni laajeɔ lɛ aba shi Etsiɔ jwɛi dumɔwui anaa koni amɛkakwɛ̃ oya ni efiteɔ yɛ be ni sa mli koni ekɛha shikpɔŋ lɛ niyenii.

english: Why does topsoil on my sloping land wash away every time heavy rain falls?
ga: Mɛni hewɔ shikpɔŋ ni yɔɔ mishikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ shwieɔ shi be fɛɛ be ni nugbɔ baanɛ lɛ?

english: Bare soil on slopes offers no resistance to flowing rainwater. Root networks and plant ground covers are needed to hold the dirt together and slow down runoff so soil stays in place.
ga: Shikpɔŋ ni nɔ bɛ ni yɔɔ gɔŋji lɛ anɔ lɛ nyɛŋ adamɔ nugbɔ nu ni hoɔ lɛ naa. Shishifãi kɛ shikpɔŋ nɔ nibii ni akɛhaa shikpɔŋ lɛ he tsɔne he miihia koni ekɛ muji lɛ afee ekome ni ekɛha nu ni hoɔ lɛ aya hiɛ fiofio koni shikpɔŋ lɛ ahi he ni eyɔɔ lɛ.

english: Why is the government asking us to cut down old cocoa trees that still give us a few pods?
ga: Mɛni hewɔ nɔyeli lɛ biɔ ni wɔfolɔ kookoo tsei momo ni yɔɔ ŋmɔtɔ lolo lɛ wɔha wɔ lɛ?

english: Old or sick cocoa trees often carry viruses like Cocoa Swollen Shoot Disease that quickly spread to nearby healthy farms. Cutting them down completely and replanting with fresh seedlings is the only way to clean the land and guarantee bigger harvests in the future.
ga: Bei pii lɛ, cacao tsei ni egbɔ loo hela mɔ amɛ lɛ hiɛɔ helai tamɔ cacao bloat ni gbɛɔ eshwaa oya kɛyaa ŋmɔji ni yɔɔ hewalɛ ni bɛŋkɛ lɛ amli. Amɛ ni abaakpa kwraa ni akɛ dumɔwui heei adu ekoŋŋ lɛ ji gbɛ pɛ ni atsɔɔ nɔ atsuuɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ ni anáa nɔmimaa akɛ abaakpa ŋmaa babaoo wɔsɛɛ.

english: Young cocoa plants are tender and cannot handle direct sunlight. They need shade crops like plantains planted alongside them to act as living umbrellas, keeping the ground cool and moist until the cocoa grows strong enough.
ga: Kakao tsei bibii lɛ yɛ mlɛo ni amɛnyɛŋ amɛŋmɛ hulu la ni tsoɔ tɛ̃ɛ lɛ gbɛ. Tsei ni haa amɛhe hulutsoo, tamɔ plantains ni adu yɛ amɛmasɛi lɛ he miihia amɛ. Koni etsu nii akɛ ŋwɛi ŋta ni hiɛ ka Ha shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ afee fɛ̃i ni edɔ kɛyashi be mli ni kookoo lɛ baatsɔ hewalɛ bɔ ni sa.

english: How long will I have to wait for new cocoa seedlings to start bearing pods after replanting?
ga: Kɛ́ adu lɛ sɛɛ lɛ, be enyiɛ esa akɛ mamɛ ni kookoo dumɔwui heei lɛ afee ŋmeii?

english: With modern hybrid cocoa varieties, the trees usually start producing pods within 2 to 3 years, unlike older traditional varieties that took 4 to 5 years.
ga: kɛ ŋmɛnɛŋmɛnɛ beaŋ hybrid cocoa henɔi Bei pii lɛ Tsei jeɔ shishi amɛwoɔ ŋmeii yɛ afii 2 kɛyashi 3 mli, esoro no kwraa yɛ blema cocoa henɔi ni heɔ afii 4 kɛyashi 5 lɛ ahe.

english: Why do the stems of my cocoa trees swell up before the leaves start changing color?
ga: Mɛni hewɔ cacao tsei lɛ ashishifãi lɛ shwieɔ shi dani baai lɛ jeɔ shishi amɛtsakeɔ amɛhe lɛ?

english: Swollen stems are the main sign of Cocoa Swollen Shoot Virus Disease. The virus blocks the flow of water and plant food inside the stem, causing it to swell and eventually starving the tree from the inside.
ga: Tsoi ni efuu lɛ ji okadi titri ni tsɔɔ akɛ hela ko ni jɛɔ mli baa lɛ eba, kookoo tsei ni efuu. Virus lɛ tsiɔ nu kɛ tsei aniyenii ni hoɔ yɛ tso lɛ mli lɛ naa. Enɛ haa efuɔ ni yɛ naagbee lɛ, hɔmɔ yeɔ tso lɛ kɛjɛɔ emli.

english: How can a disease travel from my neighbor's farm into my crops if I don't share farm tools with them?
ga: Te abaafee tɛŋŋ ni hela ko aya kɛjɛ mikutsoŋnyo lɛ ŋmɔ mli kɛya miŋmɔshi nibii amli? Kɛji mikɛ miŋmɔ mli nibii lɛ ejaaa amɛ

english: Many crop diseases are carried by tiny insects like mealybugs or blown across fields by the wind and splashing rain drops. Insects can feed on a sick tree and then fly over to infect your healthy trees.
ga: Kplukai bibii tamɔ mealybugs kɛ tsei ahe helai babaoo baa, loo kɔɔyɔɔ kɛ nugbɔ kɛ amɛ tsɔɔ ŋmɔji amli. Kplukai baanyɛ aye tsei ni hela mɔ amɛ ni amɛfo kɛya koni amɛyatswa otsei ni yɔɔ hewalɛ lɛ ahe hela.

english: What causes black spots to spread so fast across my cocoa pods during the wet season?
ga: Mɛni haa ŋmeii diji lɛ gbɛɔ eshwaa mi-kokoo ŋmeii lɛ anɔ oya yɛ nugbɔshiimɔ be lɛ mli?

english: Black pod disease is caused by a fungus that loves wet, cool conditions. Rain drops splash the fungal spores from the soil onto lower pods, and high humidity helps it spread quickly across the farm.
ga: Nɔ ni kɛ black pod hela baa ji ŋmei ko ni sumɔɔ shihilɛi ni mli efɔ, ni mli ejɔ. Nugbɔ nɛɔ, ni ekɛ ŋmeii ni yɔɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ shwieɔ shishigbɛ ŋmeii lɛ anɔ. Ni hulutsoo ni fa babaoo lɛ yeɔ ebuaa ni ŋmei lɛ gbɛɔ eshwaa oya yɛ ŋmɔ lɛ mli fɛɛ.

english: Why do the leaves of my crops turn yellow even when I water them regularly?
ga: Mɛni hewɔ mitso lɛ baai lɛ feɔ ŋmɔŋ eyɛ mli akɛ mikɛ nu woɔ mli daa moŋ lɛ?

english: Yellow leaves often mean the plant is lacking key soil nutrients like nitrogen, or the roots are drowning in waterlogged soil and cannot breathe. It can also be an early sign of root rot disease.
ga: Baai ŋmɔŋ tsɔɔ akɛ tso lɛ bɛ niyenii ni he hiaa yɛ sũ lɛ mli, tamɔ nitrogen, loo akɛ shishifãi lɛ emɔ sũ ni nu eyi mli obɔ lɛ mli ni enyɛɛɛ emu. Ebaanyɛ efee mra be mli okadi hu ni tsɔɔ akɛ shishifãi lɛ egbo.

english: This is often called wilt. The tree naturally drops young pods when it does not have enough food or water to feed all of them, or when bugs suck the juices out of the young stems.
ga: Bei pii lɛ, atsɛɔ enɛ akɛ shwiemɔ. Yɛ adebɔɔ mli lɛ, tsei jieɔ ŋmeii bibii kɛji niyenii loo nu ni fa bɔ ni sa ni baanyɛ aye abua amɛ fɛɛ bɛ. aloo beni kooloi bibii shwieɔ nu kɛjɛɔ tsei bibii amli lɛ

english: Is it safe to plant cassava close to my young cocoa trees to get extra food?
ga: Ani eyɛ shweshweeshwe akɛ madu ŋmei yɛ mi cacao tsei bibii lɛ ahe koni maná niyenii krokomɛi?

english: It is better to avoid planting cassava too close to young cocoa because cassava roots are very greedy for nutrients and water, which will starve and stunt your young cocoa plants.
ga: Ehi jogbaŋŋ akɛ oootsi ohe kɛjɛ ŋmei dumɔ he ni bɛŋkɛ kookoo bibii lɛ tsɔ. Nɔ hewɔ ji akɛ, ŋmei shishifãi biɔ niyenii kɛ nu babaoo. Enɛ baaha hɔmɔ aye o-cacao tsei bibii lɛ.

english: Why do I need to cut off extra branches from a tree that looks healthy?
ga: Mɛni hewɔ esa akɛ mafolɔ tso ni tamɔ nɔ ni yɔɔ hewalɛ lɛ niji ni fa fe nine lɛ?

english: Pruning removes non-fruitful branches so sunlight and air can pass through the tree freely. This reduces moist conditions where fungal diseases grow and directs the tree's energy into making bigger fruits.
ga: Kɛ́ afo tsei lɛ ahe lɛ, ajieɔ tsei niji ni wooo yibii lɛ koni hulu la kɛ kɔɔyɔɔ atsɔ tso lɛ mli oya. Enɛ haa shihilɛ ni mli edɔ ni tsɛŋemɔ helai ni haa mɔ he jɔ̃ɔ ehe lɛ daa yɛ mli lɛ baa shi, ni ekɛ tso lɛ hewalɛ tsuɔ nii ni ekɛwoɔ yibii wuji.

english: How do I know which chemical medicine is safe and approved to spray on my crops?
ga: Te mafee tɛŋŋ male tsofai ni yɔɔ shweshweeshwe ni akpɛlɛ nɔ akɛ akɛshwie miŋmɔshi nibii anɔ lɛ?

english: Agricultural extension officers provide a list of officially approved, safe chemicals for specific crops. Using unapproved chemicals can burn your crops, ruin the soil, cause health problems, or leave dangerous chemical residue on food.
ga: Okwaayeli he nitsulɔi lɛ kwɛɔ tsofai ni yɔɔ shweshweeshwe ni maŋ lɛ kpɛlɛ nɔ akɛ akɛtsuɔ nii kɛhaa ŋmɔshi nibii pɔtɛɛ komɛi lɛ anɔ. Tsofai ni akpɛlɛɛɛ nɔ ni akɛtsuɔ nii lɛ baanyɛ ashã onibii, efite shikpɔŋ lɛ, ni ekɛ helai aba. aloo ebaanyɛ eshi tsofai ni yɔɔ oshara yɛ niyenii lɛ mli

english: Why are insects still damaging my crops even after I sprayed them with medicine?
ga: Mɛni hewɔ kooloi bibii fiteɔ miŋmɔshi nii lɛ lolo eyɛ mli akɛ mikɛ tsofa shwieɔ nɔ moŋ?

english: Insects can survive if the chemical was mixed incorrectly, sprayed at the wrong time of day, or if the bugs have become resistant to that specific medicine. Also, some sprays only kill adult bugs, leaving eggs behind to hatch later.
ga: Kplukai baanyɛ ahi shi kɛji akɛ akɛ tsofai lɛ futu mli yɛ gbɛ ni ejaaa nɔ. Akɛ tsofa lɛ baashwie nɔ yɛ be ni esaaa mli loo kɛji akɛ kooloi lɛ nyɛɛɛ nakai tsofa pɔtɛɛ lɛ atsu nii. Kɛfata he lɛ, tsofai komɛi ni akɛshwieɔ mɛi anɔ lɛ gbeɔ kooloi bibii ni eda pɛ. Kɛtsɔ ŋmeii lɛ ni ashiɔ koni amɛfɔ sɛɛ mli lɛ nɔ.

english: Is it safe for me to spray my farm every week to prevent pests from coming?
ga: Ani eyɛ shweshweeshwe akɛ mafɔ miŋmɔ lɛ mli nu daa otsi koni tsɛŋemɔ helai akabote mli?

english: No, spraying every week wastes money, damages the plant leaves, and kills good insects like bees that help your crops produce fruit. You should only spray when you actually see pest damage or when advised by your extension officer.
ga: Dabi, tsofa ni akɛshwieɔ mɔ nɔ daa otsi lɛ ji shika fitemɔ. Efiteɔ tsei ahe baai ni egbeɔ kooloi kpakpai tamɔ ŋmeii ni yeɔ ebuaa onibii ni ewoɔ yibii lɛ. Esa akɛ okɛ tsofa lɛ afɔ nɔ kɛji ona nibii ni fiteɔ nii diɛŋtsɛ. aloo be mli pɛ ni enine shɛ ŋaawoo nɔ kɛjɛ hiɛyaa he nitsulɔi lɛ adɛŋ

english: Why are the leaves of my crops turning yellow during the rainy season?
ga: Mɛni hewɔ tsei ahe baai lɛ feɔ ŋmɔŋ yɛ nugbɔ be mli lɛ?

english: When the soil gets too waterlogged, root system suffocates from lack of oxygen and cannot draw up food. Yellow leaves are a sign that the plant roots are drowning or lacking nitrogen washed away by heavy rains.
ga: Kɛ nu eyi shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ tsɔ lɛ shishifãi lɛ shwieɔ shi yɛ kɔɔyɔɔ ni haa wala yibii lɛ bɛ kɛ niyenii ni anyɛɛɛ ato lɛ hewɔ. Baai ni feɔ ŋmɔŋ lɛ ji okadi ni tsɔɔ akɛ tso lɛ shishifãi lɛ miiho loo nitrogen ni nugbɔ ni nɛɔ waa lɛ efo lɛ bɛ amɛmli.

english: Planting seeds too close together forces the maize to fight for sunlight, causing them to grow tall and weak instead of spending their energy on forming thick stems and big cobs.
ga: Dumɔwui ni aduɔ yɛ he ko ni bɛŋkɛ amɛhe tsɔ lɛ baaha ŋmãa lɛ kɛ hulu la lɛ abɔ mɔdɛŋ. Enɛ haa dumɔwui lɛ daraa ni amɛgbɔjɔɔ. Mohu ɔ, e kɛ he wami tsuɔ ní kɛ peeɔ tsohi nɛ a mi wa kɛ tsohi agbohi.

english: Flowers fall off when trees lack key soil nutrients, suffer from extreme heat and drought stress, or when there are no tiny insects (midges) around to pollinate the blossoms.
ga: Fɔfɔii shwieɔ shi kɛ́ tso lɛ bɛ niyenii ni he hiaa yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ mli. ni hulutsoo ni naa wa kɛ hɔmɔ he haomɔ baa Aloo be mli ni kooloi bibii (teŋgbɛ nibii) bɛ he ni amɛbaawo fɔfɔi lɛ amli ŋmɔtɔ.

english: How can I tell if an insect on my farm is destroying my crops or helping them?
ga: Te mafee tɛŋŋ male kɛji kooloi bibii ni yɔɔ miŋmɔ lɛ mli lɛ miifite miŋmɔshi nibii loo amɛmiiye amɛmiibua amɛ?

english: Pests usually chew visible holes in leaves, bore into fruits, or curl up leaves to suck sap. Beneficial insects, like spiders and ladybugs, actively hunt down those pests or help pollinate your crop flowers.
ga: Bei pii lɛ, kooloi ni yeɔ mɔ awui lɛ yeɔ bu ni anaa yɛ baai lɛ amli. afolɔ awo aduawai amli loo abɔleɔ baai lɛ ahe koni ekɛnu nu lɛ Kooloi ni he yɔɔ sɛɛnamɔ tamɔ ŋmeii kɛ ŋmeii Bei pii lɛ amɛtaoɔ nakai kooloi lɛ loo amɛyeɔ amɛbuaa ni amɛwoɔ fɔfɔi ni okwɛɔ lɛ amli ŋmeii.

english: What causes black spots to spread rapidly across my plant leaves during damp weather?
ga: Mɛni haa ŋmeii diji lɛ gbɛɔ eshwaa mitsei lɛ ahe oya yɛ be mli ni hulutsoo be lɛ mli lɛ?

english: High humidity and wet leaves create the perfect condition for fungal diseases to grow. Spores travel through wind and rain droplets, causing dark spots and leaf rot.
ga: Fɛ̃i ni fa babaoo kɛ baai ni efɔ lɛ haa shihilɛ ni hi jogbaŋŋ kɛha ŋmeii adalɛ baa. Spores lɛ tsɔɔ kɔɔyɔɔ kɛ nugbɔshiimɔi amli. Ekɛ ŋmɔtɔ kɛ baai ni fiteɔ baa.

english: Why do tiny insects attack and ruin my stored grains so quickly after harvest?
ga: Mɛni hewɔ kooloi bibii tutuaa midumɔwui ni mikɛto lɛ ni amɛfiteɔ amɛ oya yɛ ŋmaakpamɔ sɛɛ lɛ?

english: Grains often carry hidden insect eggs from the field, or bugs crawl in if the storage bags are not clean. If grains are not dried completely before storage, moisture attracts pests that multiply fast.
ga: Bei pii lɛ, ŋmaa hiɛɔ kooloi bibii ni yɔɔ teemɔŋ kɛjɛɔ ŋmɔji amli. Aloo kooloi bibii baabote mli kɛji akɛ kotoku ni akɛtoɔ nii lɛ mli tseee. Kɛji akɛ dumɔwui lɛ egbiko kwraa dani akɛtoɔ lɛ Fɛ̃i gbalaa kooloi ni yeɔ mɔ awui ni amɛshwereɔ oya lɛ.

english: Why does clearing weeds from around my crop roots make them grow faster?
ga: Mɛni hewɔ ehe hiaa ni ajie jwɛi ni yɔɔ jɛmɛ lɛ? No hewɔ lɛ, mitsei lɛ ashishifãi lɛ haa amɛdaraa oya.

english: Weeds steal water, sunlight, and fertilizer meant for your main crop. Removing them allows your crops to get full nutrition and space to develop strong roots.
ga: Jwɛi juɔ nu, hulu la, kɛ ŋmɔshi nibii ni ato he gbɛjianɔ kɛha onibii titrii lɛ. Amɛ ni ajieɔ lɛ haa tso lɛ niyenii kɛ gbɛ ni fa bɔ ni sa ni ekɛ shishifãi ni wa baa.

english: Yellow leaves usually mean the corn plant lacks nitrogen, an essential soil nutrient. Adding nitrogen-rich fertilizer or well-decomposed animal manure helps the leaves turn deep green so the plant can make food and produce big cobs.
ga: Baai ŋmɔŋ tsɔɔ akɛ nitrogen, ni ji niyenii ni he hiaa waa yɛ sũ lɛ mli lɛ bɛ ŋmãa tso lɛ mli. Kɛ́ akɛ ŋmɔshi nibii ni nitrogen eyi mli obɔ loo kooloo ŋmɔshi nibii ni efite jogbaŋŋ fata he lɛ, ebaaye ebua ni baai lɛ atsɔ ŋmɔŋ ni mli edɔ bɔni afee ni tsei lɛ anyɛ awo niyenii ni amɛwo ŋmɔshi nibii wuji.

english: Why do extension officers ask me to plant groundnuts or beans on my field after harvesting maize?
ga: Mɛni hewɔ extension official lɛ biɔ mi akɛ madu ŋmei loo ŋmei yɛ miŋmɔ lɛ mli beni akpa ŋmei lɛ sɛɛ lɛ?

english: Maize takes a lot of nutrients out of the soil, but legumes like groundnuts and beans take nitrogen from the air and put it back into the earth. Rotating these crops naturally restores soil fertility for the next planting season.
ga: Abɛi gbalaa niyenii babaoo kɛjɛɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ mli. Shi ŋmeii tamɔ ŋmeii kɛ ŋmeii jieɔ nitrogen kɛjɛɔ kɔɔyɔɔ mli ni amɛkɛkuɔ amɛsɛɛ amɛyaa shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ. Nibii nɛɛ ni atsakeɔ yɛ adebɔɔ naa lɛ yeɔ ebuaa ni ehaa shikpɔŋ lɛ feɔ ŋmɔshi nii ekoŋŋ yɛ ŋmɔshi nibii ni yaa hiɛ lɛ amli.

english: How does adding animal manure to my farm help my crops survive hot weather?
ga: Mɛɛ gbɛ nɔ miŋmɔ mli kooloi ashishifãi ni mikɛwoɔ mli lɛ yeɔ ebuaa miŋmɔshi nibii lɛ ni amɛhiɔ shi yɛ kɔɔyɔŋ ni mli edɔ lɛ mli?

english: Animal manure improves the soil's structure, acting like a sponge that holds onto rainwater longer. It prevents the soil from drying out quickly, giving crop roots a steady water supply during warm dry stretches.
ga: Koolooi ashishifã haa shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ feɔ fɛo kɛtsɔ efeemɔ tamɔ sponji ni haa nugbɔ nu hiɔ shi be kakadaŋŋ lɛ nɔ. Eyeɔ ebuaa koni shikpɔŋ lɛ akagbi oya. Ehaa nu ni akɛduɔ shishifãi lɛ daa yɛ be kakadaŋŋ mli ni kɔɔyɔɔ lɛ mli egbi.

english: Young cocoa trees have fragile leaves and shallow roots that burn easily under direct sunlight. Planting fast-growing shade plants like plantains nearby protects young cocoa from harsh sun and keeps the surrounding air moist.
ga: Kakao tsei bibii lɛ yɛ baai ni waaa kɛ shishifãi ni mli ekwɔɔɔ ni shãa oya yɛ hulu la mli tɛ̃ɛ. Kɛ́ adu tsei ni shwereɔ oya tamɔ plantains yɛ he ko ni bɛŋkɛ lɛ lɛ, ebaaye ebua ni ebu kookoo bibii ahe kɛjɛ hulu la ni naa wa lɛ he. ni eyeɔ ebuaa ni ehaa kɔɔyɔɔ ni ebɔle ehe lɛ feɔ ŋmɔlɔŋmɔlɔ

english: What is making small holes in the middle leaves of my young corn plants?
ga: Mɛni kɛ buji bibii lɛ baa? Yɛ mi-abɛi tso bibioo lɛ teŋgbɛ baa lɛ nɔ

english: This damage is usually caused by Fall Armyworm caterpillars that feed on tender inner leaves. Checking your corn field early and applying recommended bio-pesticides or neem extracts into the central leaves helps protect the crop.
ga: Bei pii lɛ, Fall Armyworm ŋmeii ni yeɔ mligbɛ baai ni yɔɔ blɛoo lɛ ji nɔ ni kɛ nɛkɛ fitemɔ nɛɛ baa. Abɛi ŋmɔji amli kwɛmɔ mra Ni akɛ bio-insecticide loo neem extract ni atsɔɔ akɛ akɛbaatsu nii yɛ baa ni yɔɔ teŋgbɛ lɛ nɔ lɛ baaye abua ni abu ŋmɔshi nibii lɛ ahe.

english: Weeds act as thieves in your farm—they aggressively pull water, light, and soil nutrients away from your crops. Clearing weeds early ensures your planted crops get all the resources they need to grow strong.
ga: Jwɛi tsuɔ nii tamɔ julɔi yɛ oŋmɔ lɛ mli. Amɛjieɔ nu, la, kɛ sũ mli nibii ni haa mɔ hewalɛ kɛjɛɔ onibii amli lɛ waa. Jwɛi ni ajieɔ mra Enɛ yeɔ ebuaa ni okwɛɔ koni odumɔi lɛ aná nibii fɛɛ ni he hiaa amɛ koni amɛdara waa.

english: Tomato flowers drop when the soil gets too dry, when temperatures get excessively hot, or if the plant lacks water during flowering. Keeping the soil evenly moist with regular watering helps the flowers stay attached and set fruit.
ga: Tomato fɔfɔi lɛ baagbee shi kɛji shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ egbi tsɔ. Kɛji hulutsoo be lɛ mli wa tsɔ loo kɛji tso lɛ bɛ nu yɛ be mli ni ewoɔ fɔfɔii lɛ Kɛ́ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ edɔ kɛtsɔ nu ni akɛhaa lɛ daa lɛ nɔ lɛ, ebaaye ebua fɔfɔi lɛ ni amɛkpɛtɛ amɛhe ni amɛwo yibii.

english: Why should I remove some of the shoots growing around the base of my plantain plant?
ga: Mɛni hewɔ esa akɛ majie ŋmeii fɛɛ ni kwɛ̃ɔ yɛ ehe lɛ? Ajie mi dumɔwui lɛ ashishitoo lɛ

english: When too many young shoots grow around one plantain plant, they compete with the mother plant for nutrients. Leaving only two or three strong shoots ensures the main plant gets enough energy to bear large, heavy bunches.
ga: Beni ŋmeii bibii babaoo kwɛ̃ɔ yɛ dumɔwu kome he lɛ. Amɛbaatswa akaŋ koni amɛná niyenii ni jɛɔ tso lɛ nyɛ lɛ mli lɛ. Kɛ́ ashi tsei enyɔ loo etɛ pɛ ni yɔɔ hewalɛ lɛ, ebaaha tso titri lɛ aná hewalɛ ni fa bɔ ni sa ni ekɛbaawo tsei niji wuji ni tsii.

english: Why do we build big dirt mounds to plant yams instead of planting directly on flat ground?
ga: Mɛni hewɔ wɔmaa sũ gɔji wuji koni wɔkɛdu sweet potatoes yɛ nɔ najiaŋ ni wɔbaadu yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ tɛ̃ɛ lɛ?

english: Yam tubers grow large underground and need soft, loose, well-drained soil to expand easily. High mounds protect the growing tubers from rot by keeping heavy rain from pooling around the roots.
ga: Sweet potato tsei lɛ daraa agbo yɛ shikpɔŋ shishi ni amɛbiɔ shikpɔŋ ni yɔɔ bɔdɔɔ, ni yɔɔ ŋmɔlɔŋmɔlɔ, ni nu hoɔ yɛ mli jogbaŋŋ koni amɛgbɛ amɛshwã oya. Pii ni kwɔlɔ lɛ buɔ bulbs ni miida lɛ ahe koni amɛkafite kɛtsɔ nugbɔ ni nɛɔ waa ni amɛtsiɔ naa koni ekabɔle shishifãi lɛ ahe lɛ nɔ.

english: The mature middle part of the cassava stem makes the best planting material because it contains stored food and strong buds ready to sprout. Stems that are too green and young dry out fast, while stems that are too old sprout very slowly.
ga: Kasava tso lɛ teŋgbɛ fã ni eda lɛ ji nɔ ni hi fe fɛɛ ni akɛduɔ. Nɔ hewɔ ji akɛ, niyenii ni ato he gbɛjianɔ yɛ jɛmɛ, ni ŋmeii ni he wa hu yɛ ni esa akɛ amɛkwɛ̃. Tsoi ashishifãi ni yɔɔ ŋmɔŋ tsɔ ni amɛdarako tsɔ lɛ baagbi oya. yɛ be mli ni tsei ahe tsei ni egbɔ tsɔ lɛ baakwɛ̃ blɛoo waa.

english: Yam plants are vines that need to spread their leaves out in full sunlight to make food for growing big tubers underground. Lifting the leaves off the damp ground also prevents soil-borne fungal diseases from rotting the stems and leaves.
ga: Sweet potato tsei ji wain tsei ni esa akɛ amɛgbɛ amɛbai lɛ amɛshwã koni amɛná hulu la ni fa babaoo koni amɛha niyenii aha shikpɔŋ shishi ŋmeii wuji ni miida lɛ. Baai ni ajieɔ kɛjɛɔ hei ni ŋmɔtɔ yɔɔ lɛ hu yeɔ ebuaa ni ehaaa tsɛŋemɔ helai ni jɛɔ sũ mli baa lɛ akafite tsei lɛ kɛ baai lɛ.

english: What will happen to my pepper crop if I plant the seedlings very close to each other?
ga: Mɛni baaba mi-pepper tsei lɛ anɔ kɛji mikɛ dumɔwui lɛ bɛŋkɛ amɛhe tsɔ?

english: When pepper plants are crowded, they fight each other for sunlight, water, and soil food, resulting in thin, weak stems with very few peppers. Crowded plants also trap wet air between their leaves, making it easier for leaf rot and diseases to spread.
ga: Kɛji akɛ pepper tsei lɛ ebɔle amɛhe babaoo lɛ Amɛyeɔ hulu la, nu kɛ niyenii ni yɔɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ mli lɛ he akaŋ. Enɛ haa ŋmeii ni yɔɔ mlɛo ni bɛ hewalɛ kɛ ŋmeii fioo ko pɛ baa. Tsei ni mli eyi obɔ lɛ hu mɔ̃ɔ kɔɔyɔɔ ni mli efɔ yɛ baai lɛ ateŋ. Enɛ haa baai lɛ fiteɔ ni helai gbɛɔ eshwaa oya.

english: Yellow leaves usually mean your maize is hungry for nitrogen, which is the key food plants need to build strong leaves. It can also happen when heavy rain washes the soil nutrients too deep for the roots to reach.
ga: Bei pii lɛ, baai ni yɔɔ ŋmɔŋ lɛ tsɔɔ akɛ nitrogen he miihia o-corn lɛ. Enɛ ji niyenii titri ni he hiaa tsei koni amɛná baai ni wa. Ebaanyɛ eba hu kɛ́ nugbɔ ni nɛɔ waa lɛ hoɔ niyenii mli nibii ni yɔɔ sũ lɛ mli lɛ mli shɔŋŋ fe bɔ ni shishifãi lɛ baanyɛ ashɛ he.

english: Why does my land produce smaller crop yields when I plant maize on the exact same spot every year?
ga: Mɛni hewɔ mishikpɔŋ lɛ wooo yibii babaoo kɛ́ midu ŋmãa yɛ he kome daa afi lɛ?

english: Planting maize repeatedly on the same land drains the specific soil nutrients that maize loves to eat. Rotating your maize with nitrogen-fixing crops like groundnuts or cowpeas gives the soil a rest and naturally refills the plant food.
ga: Kɛ́ adu ŋmãa shii abɔ yɛ he kome too lɛ nɔŋŋ lɛ, ebaaha sũ mli niyenii pɔtɛɛ ni ŋmãa sumɔɔ ni eye lɛ afite. Abele ni akɛ nitrogen-fixing ŋmɔshi nibii tamɔ ŋmei loo tsina ŋmei tsakeɔ lɛ baaha shikpɔŋ lɛ aná hejɔɔmɔ ni ekɛ adebɔɔ mli tsei aniyenii aba ekoŋŋ.

english: Why does spreading dry grass on the soil around my tomato plants help them grow better?
ga: Mɛni hewɔ ehe hiaa ni agbɛ jwɛi ni egbi ashwã shikpɔŋ ni ebɔle he lɛ nɔ lɛ? No hewɔ lɛ, mi-tomato tsei lɛ yeɔ ebuaa amɛ ni amɛdaraa jogbaŋŋ.

english: Covering the soil with dry grass acts as a protective blanket called mulch. It keeps the blazing sun from baking the soil, stops water from evaporating quickly so roots stay hydrated, and prevents weeds from taking over.
ga: Mulching ni egbi lɛ tsuɔ nii akɛ nɔ ni buɔ mɔ he ni ale lɛ akɛ mulch. Eyeɔ ebuaa ni hulu la ni tsoɔ waa lɛ akashã shikpɔŋ lɛ. Ehaa nu lɛ shwieɔ oya. Koni shishifãi lɛ afee ŋmɔtɔ ni jwɛi akaye nɔ.

english: Extra shoots, called suckers, act like extra mouths to feed and steal food and water away from the main mother plantain tree. Cutting off extra suckers leaves enough food for the main stem to grow huge, heavy bunches of plantain.
ga: Tsobii krokomɛi ni atsɛɔ amɛ suckers lɛ tsuɔ nii tamɔ naabu krokomɛi ni yeɔ niyenii kɛ nu ni amɛjuɔ kɛjɛɔ dumɔwu titri lɛ he. Kɛ́ afolɔ tsei ni fa fe nine lɛ, ebaaha niyenii ni fa bɔ ni sa aha tso lɛ yitso titri lɛ koni etsɔ plantains akuu agbo ko ni tsii.

english: Tomato plants drop their flowers when they get stressed, especially by extreme hot weather or when the soil goes from completely dry to flooded. Steady watering during flowering keeps the plant calm so flowers can turn into tomatoes.
ga: Tomato tsei lɛ baashwie amɛfɔfɔi lɛ anɔ kɛji amɛhao. Enɛ ji anɔkwale titri yɛ be mli ni kɔɔyɔɔ mli edɔ waa loo be mli ni shikpɔŋ lɛ tsakeɔ kɛjɛɔ shikpɔŋ ni egbi kwraa kɛyaa nu afua mli. Kɛ́ afɔ tso lɛ nu daa yɛ be mli ni ewoɔ fɔfɔi lɛ, eyeɔ ebuaa ni ehaa tso lɛ feɔ dioo. No sɛɛ lɛ, fɔfɔi lɛ bafeɔ tomato.

english: Why are my cassava leaves twisting up and getting pale yellow patches?
ga: Mɛni hewɔ mi-cassava baai lɛ etsɔ ŋmɔlɔŋmɔlɔ ni eyɛ ŋmɔlɔŋmɔlɔ lɛ?

english: Curled leaves with light yellow patterns are a sign of Cassava Mosaic Disease, which is spread by tiny flying white insects called whiteflies. The disease stops the leaves from catching sunlight, which leads to tiny, poor-quality cassava roots.
ga: Baai ni ebɔle amɛhe ni amɛhe yɔɔ ŋmɔlɔŋmɔlɔ lɛ ji yucca mosaic hela lɛ he okadi. Kooloi bibii yɛŋ ni foɔ lɛ gbɛɔ eshwaa. ni atsɛɔ lɛ whitefly Hela nɛɛ haa baai lɛ shɛɛɛ hulu la he. Nɔ ni jɛ mli ba ji akɛ, ŋmei shishifãi lɛ daraaa, ni amɛhe ehiaaa.

english: Why are there ragged holes in my maize leaves with tiny brown powder inside the funnel?
ga: Mɛni hewɔ mi-abele baa lɛ mli buji ni etse kɛ powda bibii ni tsuɔ tamɔ ŋmɔtɔ lɛ? yɛ kɔni lɛ mli

english: Ragged holes and powdery droppings inside the leaves are signs of the Fall Armyworm pest eating your crop. Treating the central funnel of the plant early prevents the caterpillars from destroying the growing tip of the maize.
ga: Buji ni etse kɛ ŋmɔtɔ ni akɛfee powda yɛ baai amli lɛ ji Fall Armyworm hela ni yeɔ onibii lɛ ahe okadii. Tso lɛ teŋgbɛ gbɛ lɛ he nitsumɔ mra Enɛ baatsi ŋmeii lɛ anaa koni amɛkafite ŋmeii lɛ ashishifãi ni miida lɛ.

english: This usually happens when your soil is low on nitrogen, which gives plants their green color. The maize plant moves its remaining food to the new leaves at the top to stay alive, leaving the older leaves at the bottom yellow and hungry.
ga: Bei pii lɛ, enɛ baa mli kɛ́ nitrogen faaa yɛ oshikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ. ni haa tsei feɔ eŋɔli Abɛi tso lɛ tsiɔ niyenii ni eshwɛ lɛ kɛyaa baai heei ni yɔɔ ŋwɛi lɛ anɔ koni ehi wala mli. Enɛ haa baai ni edara lɛ feɔ ŋmɔŋ ni hɔmɔ yeɔ amɛ yɛ shishigbɛ.

english: Why do the leaves on my pepper plants curl up tightly during the hottest part of the afternoon?
ga: Mɛni hewɔ baai ni yɔɔ pepper tsei anɔ lɛ shwieɔ shi shiŋŋ yɛ shwane mli be ni hulu lɛ tsoɔ waa lɛ mli lɛ?

english: Leaves curl up to protect the plant from losing too much water in intense heat. It acts like closing a door to trap moisture inside the plant when the weather gets dry and hot.
ga: Baai lɛ shwieɔ shi koni ebu tso lɛ he koni nu babaoo akafite yɛ latsaa ni naa wa mli. Etsuɔ nii tamɔ shinaa ni agbeɔ koni ekɛmɔ ŋmɔtɔ ni yɔɔ tso lɛ mli lɛ mli kɛ́ kɔɔyɔɔ lɛ mli egbi ni edɔ.

english: Why do my cassava plants have huge green leaves, but the tubers underground turn out very small?
ga: Mɛni hewɔ mi-cassava tso lɛ hiɛ baai agboi ni yɔɔ ŋmɔji lɛ? Shi shikpɔŋ shishi ŋmeii lɛ daraaa kwraa?

english: When soil has too much leafy fertilizer (nitrogen) or too much water, the cassava puts all its energy into growing leaves above ground instead of storing starch in the root tubers below.
ga: Beni shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ baa ŋmɔshi nibii (nitrogen) loo nu babaoo tsɔ. Yucca kɛ ehewalɛ fɛɛ baawo baai ni miida yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ amli. Mohu ɔ, a kɛ starch toɔ tso ɔ sisi fã nɛ ngɛ sisi ɔ mi.

english: Why do tomato flowers keep falling off my plants before turning into actual fruit?
ga: Mɛni hewɔ tomato fɔfɔii miiho kɛmiijɛ mitso lɛ nɔ dani ebatsɔ anɔkwa yibii lɛ?

english: Tomato flowers drop off when daytime temperatures get too high or when watering is irregular. High heat damages the flower's pollen, causing the plant to drop the flower instead of growing a tomato.
ga: Tomato fɔfɔi lɛ baagbee shi kɛji hulutsoo be lɛ mli wa tsɔ yɛ gbi lɛ mli loo kɛji nu ni akɛwoɔ mli lɛ ejaaa. Dɔlɛ ni naa wa lɛ fiteɔ fɔfɔii amli ŋmɔtɔ. Ha fɔfɔii agbo yɛ tomato ni oookwɛ lɛ najiaŋ.

english: Why do young cocoa trees survive better when I plant plantains right next to them?
ga: Mɛni hewɔ cacao tsei bibii lɛ hiɔ shi jogbaŋŋ kɛ́ midu dumɔwui yɛ amɛmasɛi lɛ?

english: Young cocoa seedlings burn easily under direct sunlight. Plantains grow very fast and have large leaves that act as living umbrellas, shading the cocoa and keeping the soil cool during its first few years.
ga: Cacao tsei bibii lɛ shãa oya yɛ hulu la ni tsoɔ tɛ̃ɛ shishi. Plantains lɛ daa oya waa ni eyɛ baai wuji ni tsuɔ nii akɛ ŋmɔlɔ kɛhaa kookoo lɛ ni ehaa shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ fɛ̃ɔ yɛ klɛŋklɛŋ afii fioo lɛ amli.

english: Why do my crops grow tall and thin with weak stems when I plant seeds too close together?
ga: Mɛni hewɔ miŋmɔshi nibii lɛ kɛlɛ ni amɛhe ejɔ ni amɛshishifãi lɛ bɛ hewalɛ beni miduɔ dumɔwui lɛ yɛ he ko ni bɛŋkɛ amɛhe tsɔ lɛ?

english: When seeds are planted too close, they fight each other for sunlight. The plants stretch upward as fast as possible to beat their neighbors to the light, making them thin, weak, and easy to fall over in wind.
ga: Kɛji adu dumɔwui ni bɛŋkɛ tsɔ Dumɔwui kɛ amɛhe woɔ hulu la he akaŋ. Tsei baagbala amɛhe oya bɔ ni amɛaanyɛ koni amɛtswa amɛkutsoŋbii lɛ amɛwo la lɛ mli. Enɛ haa tsei lɛ feɔ mlɛo, amɛhe waaa, ni kɛ́ kɔɔyɔɔ tswa amɛ lɛ, amɛgbeeɔ shi oya.

english: Yam vines need direct sunlight on all their leaves to make food for big tubers. Staking lifts the leaves off the dark ground into the sun and prevents soil diseases from rotting the stems.
ga: Sweet potato wain tsei lɛ he miihia hulu la tɛ̃ɛ yɛ amɛbaai lɛ fɛɛ anɔ koni amɛfee niyenii amɛha amɛ bulbs wuji lɛ. Staking woɔ baai kɛjɛɔ hei ni duŋ yɔɔ lɛ kɛyaa hulu la mli, ni ehaa helai ni jɛɔ sũ mli baa lɛ naa koni amɛkafite tsei lɛ ashishifãi lɛ.

english: Cowpeas and beans are special plants that pull nitrogen out of the air and put it into the soil through their roots. When they die, they leave natural fertilizer behind for crops like maize.
ga: Cowpeas kɛ beans ji tsei krɛdɛɛi ni jieɔ nitrogen kɛjɛɔ kɔɔyɔɔ mli ni amɛkɛwoɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ mli kɛtsɔɔ amɛshishifãi lɛ anɔ. Kɛ́ amɛgboi lɛ, amɛshiɔ adebɔɔ mli ŋmɔshi nibii kɛhaa ŋmɔshi nibii tamɔ ŋmãa.

english: Why do small caterpillars hide inside the funnel of my young maize leaves and eat holes in them?
ga: Mɛni hewɔ ŋmeii bibii kɛ amɛhe woɔ mi-baby corn baai lɛ amli ni amɛyeɔ bu yɛ mli lɛ?

english: These caterpillars, often Fall Armyworms, hide inside the central funnel because it is moist, shaded, and soft to eat, protecting them from hot sun and birds while they feed.
ga: Nɛkɛ ŋmeii nɛɛ ni bei pii lɛ amɛgbeeɔ shi akɛ asraafoi ŋmeii lɛ, kɛ amɛhe woɔ ŋmeii ni yɔɔ teŋgbɛ lɛ amli ejaakɛ amɛhe yɛ ŋmɔlɔ, amɛyɛ hulutsoo, ni amɛhe yɛ blɛoo ni ayeɔ. Ebuɔ amɛhe kɛjɛɔ hulu ni tsoɔ waa lɛ kɛ okpoi ahe be mli ni amɛyeɔ nii lɛ.

english: Why are the bottoms of my green pepper fruits turning black and rotten before they ripen?
ga: Mɛni hewɔ mi-chili eŋɔli lɛ shishigbɛ lɛ miifee ediŋŋ ni egboɔ dani eshɛɔ lɛ?

english: This is called blossom-end rot. It happens when the plant cannot take up enough calcium from the soil, usually caused by irregular watering or long dry periods between rain.
ga: Atsɛɔ enɛ akɛ fɔfɔi naagbee fitemɔ. Ebaa kɛji tsei nyɛɛɛ ana calcium ni fa bɔ ni sa kɛjɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ mli. Bei pii lɛ, nɔ ni kɛ enɛ baa ji nu ni ashwieɔ shi be fɛɛ be loo nugbɔshiimɔ ni sɛɛ tsɛɔ yɛ nugbɔshiimɔi ateŋ.

english: Young cocoa trees cannot handle direct sunlight and high heat. They need shade crops like plantains or shade trees planted around them to protect their leaves from scorching and to keep the soil moist.
ga: Kakao tsei bibii lɛ nyɛŋ aŋmɛ hulu la ni tsoɔ tɛ̃ɛ kɛ dɔlɛ ni naa wa lɛ gbɛ. Amɛmiitao tsei ni haa hulutsoo tamɔ tsei bibii loo hulutsoo tsei ni adu yɛ amɛhe lɛ. Enɛ ji koni akɛbu baai lɛ ahe kɛjɛ shãa he, ni koni shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ afee ŋmɔlɔŋmɔlɔ.

english: This is caused by Black Pod disease, a fungus that spreads rapidly in dark, wet, and humid conditions. Pruning excess branches lets sunlight and air in, and removing infected pods helps prevent the fungus from spreading to healthy pods.
ga: Black pod hela lɛ kɛ enɛ baa. Enɛ ji tsɛŋemɔ hela ko ni gbɛɔ eshwaa oya yɛ hei ni edɔ, ŋmɔtɔ, kɛ ŋmɔtɔ. Kpɔ̃ɔ tsei niji ni fa fe nine lɛ koni hulu la kɛ kɔɔyɔɔ abote mli Ni kɛ́ ojie ŋmeii ni hela emɔ amɛ lɛ, eyeɔ ebuaa ni ŋmeii lɛ akagbɛ amɛshwã ŋmeii ni yɔɔ hewalɛ amli.

english: Why are my maize leaves turning pale yellow from the bottom up even when there is enough rain?
ga: Mɛni hewɔ mi-abele baai lɛ feɔ ŋmɔŋ kɛjɛɔ shishi kɛyaa ŋwɛi eyɛ mli akɛ nugbɔ nɛ bɔ ni sa moŋ?

english: Yellow leaves starting from the bottom usually mean the plant lacks nitrogen, an essential soil nutrient for green growth. Adding organic manure or nitrogen-rich fertilizer helps the maize regain its deep green color and produce good yields.
ga: Bei pii lɛ, baai ni ji ŋmɔŋ ni jeɔ shishi kɛjɛɔ shishi lɛ tsɔɔ akɛ nitrogen bɛ tso lɛ mli. ni ji niyenii ni he hiaa waa yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ mli kɛha ŋmɔshi nibii ni yaa hiɛ lɛ Kɛ́ akɛ ŋmɔshi nibii loo nitrogen ŋmɔshi nibii fata he lɛ, ebaaye ebua ŋmɔshi nibii lɛ ni amɛfee ŋmɔshi nibii ni mli edɔ ni amɛwo yibii kpakpai.

english: Why do people tell me to plant beans or cowpeas together with my maize?
ga: Mɛni hewɔ mɔ ko baakɛɛ mi akɛ mikɛ mi-ŋmãa lɛ adu ŋmãa loo tsina ŋmãa?

english: Legumes like beans take nitrogen from the air and put it into the soil through their roots. This feeds the maize plants naturally, improves soil health, and helps cover the soil to block weed growth.
ga: Legumes tamɔ ŋmeii lɛ jieɔ nitrogen kɛjɛɔ kɔɔyɔɔ mli ni amɛkɛwoɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ mli kɛtsɔɔ amɛshishifãi lɛ anɔ. Enɛ baaha ŋmãa tsei lɛ aye nii yɛ adebɔɔ naa. Eha shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ hewalɛ aya hiɛ ni eyeɔ ebuaa ni ehaa shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ koni jwɛi akakwɛ̃

english: Why are there small holes in my young maize leaves and caterpillars hiding inside the central shoot?
ga: Mɛni hewɔ mi-baby corn baai kɛ ŋmeii lɛ yɛ bu bibii lɛ? Akɛtee teŋgbɛ tso lɛ mli

english: This damage is caused by the Fall Armyworm pest. Early detection is key; spraying early in the morning or late evening when the worms are active protects the growing point of the plant.
ga: Fall Armyworm tsɛŋemɔ hela lɛ ji nɔ ni kɛ nɛkɛ fitemɔ nɛɛ baa, no hewɔ lɛ ehe miihia ni ana mra. Kɛ́ okɛ tsofa lɛ shwie nɔ leebi loo gbɛkɛ be mli ni ŋmeii miitsu nii lɛ, ebaaye ebua ni ebu he ni tso lɛ daa lɛ he.

english: Why do my cassava roots rot in the ground when the heavy rains begin?
ga: Mɛni hewɔ mi-cassava shishifãi lɛ fiteɔ yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ mli kɛ́ nugbɔ nɛ waa lɛ?

english: Cassava tubers rot when water sits around their roots for too long in flat or poorly drained soil. Planting cassava on raised mounds or ridges helps excess rainwater drain away quickly and keeps the roots healthy.
ga: Cassava shishifãi lɛ fiteɔ kɛji nu hi shishifãi lɛ ahe be kakadaŋŋ tsɔ yɛ shikpɔŋ ni yɔɔ ŋmɔlɔŋmɔlɔ loo shikpɔŋ ni nu hoɔ yɛ nɔ jogbaŋŋ lɛ nɔ. Kɛ́ adu ŋmei yɛ gɔŋ loo ŋshɔkpɔ ni nɔ kwɔ nɔ lɛ, nugbɔ nu ni fa fe nine lɛ hoɔ oya, ni ehaa shishifãi lɛ waa.

english: Why does my plantain stand produce much smaller bunches after the first harvest?
ga: Mɛni hewɔ mi plantains lɛ woɔ panicles bibii kwraa yɛ klɛŋklɛŋ ŋmaakpamɔ lɛ sɛɛ lɛ?

english: When too many suckers grow around the main plantain stem, they steal nutrients and water from each other. Cutting away extra suckers so only two or three strong ones remain ensures big, heavy bunches.
ga: Kɛ́ ŋmeii babaoo kwɛ̃ yɛ tso titri lɛ he lɛ, amɛjuɔ niyenii mli hewalɛ kɛ nu kɛjɛɔ amɛhe. Kɛ́ afolɔ ŋmeii ni fa fe nine lɛ amli bɔni afee ni enyɔ loo etɛ pɛ ni yɔɔ hewalɛ ahi shi lɛ, ehaa ŋmeii agbo ni tsii baa.

english: Yam vines need sunlight on all their leaves to make food for growing large tubers under the ground. Staking keeps leaves off the wet ground, increases light exposure, and reduces fungal diseases.
ga: Sweet potato wain tsei lɛ he miihia hulu la yɛ amɛbaai lɛ fɛɛ anɔ koni amɛná niyenii kɛha ŋmeii wuji ni kwɛ̃ɔ yɛ shikpɔŋ shishi lɛ. Staking baaha baai lɛ akagbee shi yɛ hei ni ŋmɔtɔ yɔɔ lɛ, ebaaha la aya hiɛ, ni ebaaha tsɛŋemɔ helai ni baa mɔ nɔ lɛ aba shi.

english: Tomato flowers often drop off due to extreme heat, irregular watering, or lack of pollination. Keeping the soil consistently moist and providing shelter during very hot days helps tomatoes set fruit properly.
ga: Bei pii lɛ, tomato fɔfɔi lɛ shwieɔ shi yɛ dɔlɛ ni naa wa waa hewɔ. Nu ni ashwieɔ nɔ be fɛɛ be loo ŋmɔtɔ ni fa bɔ ni sa Kɛ́ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ edɔ pɛpɛɛpɛ ni ehaa wɔɔhe yɛ gbii ni mli edɔ lɛ amli lɛ, eyeɔ ebuaa tomato ni ewoɔ yibii jogbaŋŋ.

english: This practice is called mulching. It acts like a protective blanket over the soil to trap moisture, keep the plant roots cool under the hot sun, stop weeds from growing, and enrich the soil as the grass breaks down.
ga: Atsɛɔ nifeemɔ nɛɛ akɛ mulching. Etsuɔ nii tamɔ nɔ ko ni buɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ he koni ekɛmɔ ŋmɔtɔ. Ha tso shishifãi lɛ afee fɛ̃i yɛ hulu ni tsoɔ waa lɛ shishi. Etsiɔ jwɛi anaa koni ekakwɛ̃ ni ehaa shikpɔŋ lɛ feɔ ŋmɔshi nii kɛji jwɛi fite

english: Why do my young cocoa seedlings die when planted directly in the open sun, while older cocoa trees do just fine?
ga: Mɛni hewɔ mi-kokoo tsei bibii lɛ gboiɔ kɛ́ adu amɛ yɛ shikpɔŋ ni nɔ tse nɔ tɛ̃ɛ lɛ? Yɛ nakai beaŋ lɛ, cacao tsei ni egbɔ lɛ tsuɔ nii jogbaŋŋ.

english: Young cocoa trees are like human babies and burn easily under full sun. They need fast-growing shade plants like plantain or banana to act as living umbrellas, giving them protection and moisture until they grow tough enough to handle direct sunlight.
ga: Cacao tsei bibii lɛ tamɔ adesai abifabii ni hulu la ni naa wa shishi lɛ shãa oya. Amɛmiitao tsei ni haa amɛnáa hulutsoo ni daa oya, tamɔ plantain loo banana. Koni etsu nii tamɔ ŋwɛi ŋta ni hiɛ ka Ha hebuu kɛ ŋmɔtɔ aahu kɛyashi amɛbaadara bɔ ni sa ni amɛbaanyɛ amɛhe hulu la tɛ̃ɛ.

english: Why should I not apply the same amount of strong fertilizer to my newly sprouted maize as I do when the crop is tall and flowering?
ga: Mɛni hewɔ esaaa akɛ mikɛ ŋmɔshi nibii ni mli ewo muji babaoo woɔ ŋmãa ni ekwɛ̃ ehee lɛ mli tamɔ bɔ ni mikɛwoɔ ŋmãa mli beni tsei lɛ ekwɛ̃ ni amɛmiiwo fɔfɔi lɛ?

english: Newly sprouted maize has delicate, tiny roots that can easily burn and die from strong, heavy fertilizer doses. Early-stage crops need smaller, milder amounts of starter nutrients to grow roots, while mature plants need larger doses to form heavy grains.
ga: Abɛi ni ekwɛ̃ ehee lɛ yɛ shishifãi bibii. Tsei ni yɔɔ mlɛo ni baanyɛ ashã ni amɛgboi oya kɛtsɔ ŋmɔshi nibii ni tsii ni akɛwoɔ mli lɛ nɔ. Tsei ni yɔɔ shishijee lɛ biɔ shishijee niyenii bibii kɛ bibii koni amɛshishifãi lɛ adara. yɛ be mli ni tsei ni eda lɛ biɔ babaoo koni amɛwo dumɔwui ni tsii.

english: Why do I need to water my vegetable nursery beds twice a day, but my full-grown tomato plants only need water once or twice a week?
ga: Mɛni hewɔ esa akɛ mawo mi-vegetables ŋmɔ lɛ mli nu shii enyɔ daa gbi lɛ? Shi tomato tsei ni eda lɛ he miihia nu shikome loo shii enyɔ pɛ yɛ otsi mli.

english: Seedlings have shallow, fragile root systems that can dry out and die within hours under hot sun. Mature tomato plants develop deep root systems that reach moisture buried deep in the ground, allowing them to survive longer between waterings.
ga: Dumɔwui yɛ shishifãi ni mli ekwɔɔɔ, ni waaa ni baanyɛ agbi ni egbo yɛ ŋmɛlɛtswai fioo komɛi amli yɛ hulu ni tsoɔ waa lɛ shishi. Tomato tsei ni eda lɛ feɔ shishifãi ni mli kwɔ ni shɛɔ ŋmɔtɔ ni afu yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ mli shɔŋŋ lɛ he. Enɛ haa amɛhiɔ shi be babaoo yɛ nu ni akɛhaa amɛ lɛ teŋ.

english: Why do my pepper seedlings droop and look half-dead right after I move them from the nursery tray into my farm?
ga: Mɛni hewɔ mi-pepper dumɔwui lɛ shwieɔ shi ni amɛfeɔ tamɔ nɔ ni eshwɛ fioo ni amɛgboi amrɔ nɔŋŋ beni mijie amɛ kɛjɛ ŋmɔ mli nibii ni akɛwoɔ ŋmɔ mli lɛ amli kɛtee miŋmɔ lɛ mli lɛ?

english: Moving plants breaks their fine, baby root hairs, causing transplant shock. Watering them immediately and transplanting in the cool late afternoon gives the young roots a chance to recover overnight without hot sunshine stressing them.
ga: Tsei ni tsiɔ amɛhe lɛ gbáa amɛshishifãi bibii lɛ amli, ni ekɛ shoofeemɔ baa kɛji akɛ atsake amɛ. Nu ni akɛwoɔ mli amrɔ nɔŋŋ ni aduɔ yɛ shwane ni hulu lɛ miitso lɛ haa shishifãi bibii lɛ naa hegbɛ ni amɛhe wa nyɔɔŋ kome mli ni hulu ni tsoɔ waa lɛ bɛ mli.

english: Why do tiny seeds like cabbage need to be planted very close to the top of the soil, while big yam sets are buried deep?
ga: Mɛni hewɔ esa akɛ adu dumɔwui bibii, tamɔ kaabɛji yɛ he ko ni bɛŋkɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ hiɛ waa lɛ? Yɛ be mli ni afuu ŋmeii babaoo ni mli kwɔ lɛ?

english: Tiny seeds carry very little stored food inside them and can only push through a thin layer of dirt to reach sunshine. Larger seed items like yam sets have plenty of stored energy to push strong shoots up through deep soil.
ga: dumɔwui bibii Niyenii fioo ko pɛ ato ni abaanyɛ atsɔ shikpɔŋ ni mli tseee lɛ mli. Koni aná hulu la pɛ Dumɔwui wuji, tamɔ sweet potato ŋmɔji lɛ, yɛ hewalɛ babaoo ni ato koni amɛkɛtsi ŋmeii ni he wa lɛ kɛtsɔ shikpɔŋ ni mli kwɔ lɛ mli.

english: Why is clearing weeds so urgent when my cassava cuttings are just sprouting, but not as critical when the field is full of mature cassava?
ga: Mɛni hewɔ ehe hiaa waa akɛ ajie jwɛi lɛ be mli ni mi yucca tsei lɛ miibɔi shweremɔ kɛkɛ lɛ? Shi ani ehe ehiaaa tamɔ be mli ni ŋmɔ lɛ mli eyi kɛ ŋmei ni eda lɛ?

english: Young sprouts are weak and cannot compete with aggressive weeds for sunlight, water, and soil food. Once cassava grows tall with broad leaves, it creates a thick shade canopy that naturally chokes out weeds on its own.
ga: Tsei bibii lɛ bɛ hewalɛ ni amɛnyɛŋ amɛkɛ jwɛi ni baa shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ abɔi hulu la, nu, kɛ shikpɔŋ nɔ niyenii. Kɛji akɛ ŋmei lɛ da ni eyɛ baai ni mli kwɔlɔ lɛ Ehaa hulutsoo ni mli edɔ ni jɛɔ adebɔɔ mli lɛ shwieɔ jwɛi lɛ.

english: Can I use regular dirt from my farm field to fill nursery bags for sprouting delicate vegetable seeds?
ga: Ani manyɛ mikɛ shikpɔŋ ni jɛɔ miŋmɔ lɛ mli daa lɛ awo grow bag mli koni mikɛdu aduawai dumɔwui ni yɔɔ mlɛo?

english: Field soil is often too heavy and dense for tiny, new roots to push through, and it can carry soil diseases. Nursery plants do best in light, loose, clean soil mixed with well-rotted compost so fragile roots can spread easily.
ga: Bei pii lɛ, shikpɔŋ ni yɔɔ ŋmɔji amli lɛ mli tsii tsɔ ni eyɛ ŋmɔlɔŋmɔlɔ ni enyɛŋ eŋmɛ gbɛ ni shishifãi heei bibii atsɔ mli, ni ebaanyɛ ekɛ helai ni jɛɔ shikpɔŋ mli baa lɛ aba. Ehi jogbaŋŋ akɛ aduɔ dumɔwui yɛ shikpɔŋ ni mli tse, ni mli tse, ni akɛ ŋmɔshi nibii ni egbo jogbaŋŋ efutu mli. Bɔni afee ni shishifãi ni waaa lɛ anyɛ agbɛ ashwã mlɛo.

english: Why do small insects completely destroy my young pepper seedlings overnight, but barely damage the leaves on older pepper bushes?
ga: Mɛni hewɔ kooloi bibii kpata mi-pepper dumɔwui bibii lɛ ahiɛ kwraa nyɔɔŋ kome mli lɛ? Shi eshwɛ fioo ni ebaafite baai ni yɔɔ ŋmɔtɔ tsei momo lɛ anɔ lɛ.

english: Young seedlings have soft, tender leaves and stems that pests easily chew through and destroy completely. Older bushes have tougher leaves and thick stems, allowing them to withstand minor pest damage without dying.
ga: Tsei bibii yɛ baai kɛ tsei ni yɔɔ bɔdɔɔ ni tsɛŋemɔ helai nyɛɔ amɛyeɔ ni amɛfiteɔ amɛ oya. Tsoi bibii ni edara lɛ yɛ baai ni wa kɛ tsei ni mli tse. Enɛ haa amɛnyɛɔ amɛshiɔ nibii bibii ni tsɛŋemɔ helai baafite amɛ lɛ ni amɛgbooo.

english: How do I know when my rice crop is ready for its second round of top-dress fertilizer?
ga: Te mafee tɛŋŋ male be ni mi-rice lɛ efee klalo kɛha ŋmɔshi nibii ni ji enyɔ lɛ?

english: Rice requires different nutrition as it grows; the second round is given right when the green stem begins to swell up at the base (panicle initiation), which gives the plant energy to build heavy grain heads.
ga: Niyenii mli hewalɛi srɔtoi he miihia ŋmãa be mli ni edaa lɛ. Akɛ kpokpaa ni ji enyɔ lɛ haa kɛji tso lɛ eŋɔli lɛ je shishi ebɔi shwiemɔ yɛ shishigbɛ pɛ. (budding initiation) ni haa tso lɛ hewalɛ ni ekɛfeɔ dumɔwui ayitsei ni tsii

english: Is it safe for me to cut off lower branches from my young papaya trees while they are still small?
ga: Ani eyɛ shweshweeshwe akɛ aaafolɔ papaya tsei bibii lɛ aniji ni yɔɔ shishigbɛ lɛ?

english: Young trees rely on all of their early leaves to make food and grow strong stems, so cutting healthy leaves too early weakens them. Pruning should mostly be done on older plants to remove yellowing, dead, or diseased leaves.
ga: Tsei bibii kɛ amɛhe fɔ̃ɔ baai bibii anɔ kwraa koni amɛkɛfee niyenii ni amɛkwɛ̃ tsei ni wa. No hewɔ lɛ, kɛ́ ofolɔ baai ni yɔɔ hewalɛ lɛ mra tsɔ lɛ, ebaaha baai lɛ afee gbɔjɔmɔ. Esa akɛ afolɔ tsei ni egbɔ lɛ ateŋ babaoo koni ajie baai ni etsɔ ŋmɔŋ, ni egboi, loo hela emɔ amɛ lɛ.

english: Young cocoa plants cannot handle direct, harsh sunlight. Planting fast-growing shade crops like plantains or bananas nearby creates a living canopy that protects the delicate seedlings from drying out and overheating.
ga: Cacao tsei bibii nyɛŋ akpɛlɛ hulu la ni naa wa ni tsoɔ tɛ̃ɛ lɛ nɔ. Shade tsei ni kwɛ̃ɔ oya tamɔ plantains loo banana ni aduɔ yɛ he ko ni bɛŋkɛ. Ehaa ŋwɛi ŋta ni hiɛ ka ni buɔ dumɔwui ni yɔɔ mlɛo lɛ ahe koni amɛkagbi ni amɛkadɔ fe nine.

english: Yellow leaves on maize usually mean the plant lacks nitrogen, a key nutrient for growth. Adding manure, compost, or nitrogen fertilizer helps the plant grow strong, healthy green leaves.
ga: Bei pii lɛ, baai ni yɔɔ ŋmɔŋ ni yɔɔ ŋmãa nɔ lɛ tsɔɔ akɛ nitrogen bɛ tso lɛ mli. ni ji niyenii ni he hiaa waa kɛha dalɛ Kɛ́ akɛ ŋmɔshi nibii, ŋmɔshi nibii, loo nitrogen ŋmɔshi nibii fata he lɛ, eyeɔ ebuaa tso lɛ ni enáa baai ni yɔɔ hewalɛ ni yɔɔ ŋmɔji.

english: Why do my cassava tubers start rotting in the soil if I leave them too long before harvesting?
ga: Mɛni hewɔ ni ŋmei shishifãi jeɔ shishi egboɔ yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ mli kɛji akɛ ashi amɛ be kakadaŋŋ tsɔ dani akpa lɛ?

english: Cassava tubers store water and starches, but if water sits around the roots for too long during heavy rains, soil fungi and bacteria cause them to decay under the ground.
ga: Cassava shishifãi lɛ hiɛɔ nu kɛ ŋmɔtɔ. Shi kɛji nu hi shishifãi lɛ ahe be kakadaŋŋ tsɔ yɛ nugbɔ ni nɛɔ waa lɛ mli lɛ, Shikpɔŋ nɔ ŋmeii kɛ helai ni baa mɔ mli lɛ baaha amɛgboi yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ shishi.

english: Yam vines need to climb high to capture maximum sunlight to make food. Staking keeps the leaves off the damp ground, preventing diseases and helping the plant produce bigger tubers.
ga: Esa akɛ sweet potato wain tsei lɛ akwɔ kɛya ŋwɛi shɔɔŋ koni amɛná hulu la babaoo bɔ ni amɛaanyɛ kɛha nihoomɔ. Staking baaha baai lɛ akashwɛ yɛ he ni ŋmɔtɔ yɔɔ lɛ. Etsiɔ helai anaa ni eyeɔ ebuaa tsei ni amɛwoɔ bulbs wuji.

english: Extra shoots, called suckers, steal water and plant food from the main stem. Removing excess shoots leaves only two or three healthy stems, ensuring the main plant gets enough energy to yield large bunches.
ga: Tso lɛ mli tsei krɛdɛɛi ni atsɛɔ amɛ shoots lɛ juɔ nu kɛ niyenii kɛjɛɔ tso lɛ shishi. Kɛji ajie ŋmeii ni fa fe nine lɛ, ebaaha ŋmeii 2-3 pɛ aba ni yɔɔ hewalɛ. Enɛ haa tso titri lɛ naa hewalɛ ni fa bɔ ni sa ni ekɛwoɔ niji wuji.

english: What causes the leaves on my tomato plants to curl up and stop growing fruit?
ga: Mɛni haa baai ni yɔɔ tomato tsei anɔ lɛ shwieɔ shi ni amɛkpaa yibiiwoo?

english: Tomato leaf curl is usually caused by tiny insects like whiteflies that spread a virus, or by extreme heat and drought stress. Protecting plants from bugs and watering consistently keeps the leaves healthy.
ga: Bei pii lɛ, kooloi bibii tamɔ whiteflies ni gbɛɔ helai amli lɛ ji nɔ ni kɛ tomato baa lɛ shwieɔ shi. aloo kɛjɛ latsaa ni naa wa kɛ hɔmɔ he haomɔ mli. Kɛ́ abu tsei ahe kɛjɛ kooloi ahe ni awo amɛ nu daa lɛ, eyeɔ ebuaa ni amɛbaa lɛ hiɔ shi jogbaŋŋ.

english: Does planting my seeds very close together give me more food at harvest time?
ga: Ani dumɔwui lɛ ni madu ni bɛŋkɛ amɛhe lɛ baaha maná niyenii babaoo yɛ kpamɔɔ be mli?

english: Planting seeds too close together forces crops to compete for sunlight, water, and soil food, resulting in thin, weak plants with small yields. Proper spacing gives each plant room to produce a full harvest.
ga: Dumɔwui ni aduɔ ni bɛŋkɛ amɛhe tsɔ lɛ nyɛɔ tsei lɛ anɔ koni amɛye hulu la, nu kɛ niyenii ni yɔɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ mli lɛ he akaŋ. Enɛ haa tsei ni yɔɔ mlɛo, ni bɛ hewalɛ, ni amɛwoɔ yibii lɛ faaa. Gbɛ ni sa ni akɛtoɔ he lɛ haa ŋmɔ fɛɛ ŋmɔ ni kwɛɔ nɔ lɛ nyɛɔ ekpaa nii babaoo.

english: Pepper plants drop their flowers when stressed by severe heat, dry soil, or a lack of key soil nutrients. Keeping soil moist and well-nourished helps flowers stay attached and turn into fruits.
ga: Pepper tsei lɛ shwieɔ amɛbaai lɛ shi kɛji dɔlɛ ni naa wa, shikpɔŋ ni egbi, loo niyenii titrii ni bɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ hao amɛ. Kɛ́ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ edɔ ni ehi jogbaŋŋ lɛ, eyeɔ ebuaa fɔfɔi lɛ ni amɛkpɛtɛɔ he ni amɛtsɔɔ aduawai.

english: The first rain is often followed by a dry spell that bakes seeds in hot soil before regular rains start. Waiting until rains become steady ensures seeds germinate safely and survive.
ga: Bei pii lɛ, nugbɔshiimɔ ni baaha dumɔwui lɛ agbi yɛ shikpɔŋ ni mli edɔ lɛ nɔ lɛ nyiɛɔ klɛŋklɛŋ nugbɔshiimɔ lɛ sɛɛ dani nugbɔshiimɔ ni baa daa lɛ jeɔ shishi. Kɛ́ omɛ ni nugbɔ nɛ be fɛɛ be lɛ, ebaaha dumɔwui lɛ akwɛ̃ shweshweeshwe ni amɛhi shi.

english: Why do some farmers cover the soil around crops with dried grass or leaves?
ga: Mɛni hewɔ okwaafoi komɛi kɛ jwɛi loo baai ni egbi shwieɔ shikpɔŋ ni bɔle amɛŋmɔshi nibii lɛ ahe lɛ?

english: Covering the ground with dry grass, known as mulching, traps water in the soil, keeps the roots cool during hot days, stops weeds from growing, and adds organic food to the soil as it decays.
ga: Atsɛɔ jwɛi ni egbi ni akɛhaa shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ hu akɛ mulching. Eyeɔ ebuaa ni nu hiɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ mli. Eyeɔ ebuaa ni shishifãi lɛ feɔ fɛ̃i yɛ gbii ni mli edɔ lɛ amli. Etsiɔ jwɛi anaa koni ekakwɛ̃ ni ekɛ niyenii ni wala yɔɔ mli fataa shikpɔŋ lɛ he beni efiteɔ lɛ.

english: Young cocoa trees burn easily under full sun. Plantains grow fast and have large leaves that act as living umbrellas, giving young cocoa trees the shade and cool air they need to survive their first few years.
ga: Cacao tsei bibii lɛ shãa oya yɛ hulu la ni naa wa shishi. Plantain lɛ daa oya ni eyɛ baai wuji ni tsuɔ nii akɛ hulutsoo. Enɛ haa kookoo tsei bibii lɛ naa hulutsoo kɛ kɔɔyɔɔ ni mli ejɔ ni he hiaa amɛ koni amɛhi shi yɛ klɛŋklɛŋ afii fioo lɛ amli.

english: Yam vines need to reach high into the air so their leaves can catch plenty of sunlight to make food for growing the tubers underground. Keeping the leaves off the damp soil also prevents them from rotting or catching fungal diseases.
ga: Esa akɛ atswa sweet potato wain tsei lɛ awo kɔɔyɔɔ mli bɔni afee ni amɛbaai lɛ aná hulu la ni fa bɔ ni sa ni baaha shikpɔŋ shishi tsei lɛ aná niyenii. Kɛ́ ajie baai lɛ kɛjɛ shikpɔŋ ni mli efɔ nɔ lɛ hu, eyeɔ ebuaa ni ehaaa amɛgboi loo tsɛŋemɔ helai ni haa mɔ he jɔ̃ɔ ehe lɛ akamɔ amɛ.

english: Yellow leaves usually mean your maize lacks nitrogen, which is the main nutrient plants use to build green leaves. Heavy rains can also wash this food out of the topsoil, leaving the plant hungry.
ga: Bei pii lɛ, baai ni yɔɔ ŋmɔŋ lɛ tsɔɔ akɛ nitrogen bɛ o-corn lɛ mli. ni ji niyenii titri ni tsei kɛtsuɔ nii kɛfeɔ baai eŋɔli Nugbɔ ni nɛɔ waa lɛ baanyɛ afɔ niyenii nɛɛ he kɛjɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ. Enɛ hewɔ lɛ, hɔmɔ yeɔ tsei lɛ.

english: Why does my cassava produce very tall stems with lots of leaves but small tubers under the ground?
ga: Mɛni hewɔ mi-cassava lɛ shishitso lɛ kɛlɛ waa ni eyɛ baai babaoo lɛ? Shi yitso bibioo ko yɛ shikpɔŋ shishi?

english: When cassava gets too much nitrogen food or when plants are crowded too close together, the plant spends all its energy growing leaves upwards to fight for sunlight instead of storing food in the underground roots.
ga: Kɛji akɛ aha ŋmei niyenii ni nitrogen babaoo yɔɔ mli loo kɛji akɛ tsei ebɔle amɛhe tsɔ Tsei kɛ amɛhewalɛ fɛɛ tsuɔ nii ni amɛkɛwoɔ baai koni amɛkɛye hulu la lɛ he akaŋ. Yɛ nɔ najiaŋ ni akɛ niyenii baato shikpɔŋ shishi shishifãi amli lɛ

english: Why do my groundnuts make the soil richer for the maize I plant in the next season?
ga: Mɛni hewɔ mi-peanuts lɛ haa shikpɔŋ lɛ feɔ nɔ ni baa shi jogbaŋŋ kɛha ŋmãa ni miduɔ yɛ be ni baa lɛ mli lɛ?

english: Groundnuts are legumes that work with friendly microbes in the soil to pull nitrogen food out of the air and fix it into the soil. When the groundnut roots decay after harvest, that food stays in the soil for the next crop.
ga: Peanuts ji ŋmeii ni kɛ nibii bibii ni yɔɔ sũ lɛ mli ni feɔ naanyo lɛ tsuɔ nii koni amɛgbala niyenii ni haa mɔ hewalɛ ni ji nitrogen lɛ kɛjɛ kɔɔyɔɔ mli ni amɛkɛto sũ lɛ mli. Beni ŋmei shishifãi lɛ fiteɔ yɛ ŋmɔshi nibii ni akpa lɛ sɛɛ Nakai niyenii lɛ baakã shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ kɛha ŋmɔshi nibii ni nyiɛ sɛɛ lɛ.

english: Why do my cocoa trees drop many of their small flowers before they can form cocoa pods?
ga: Mɛni hewɔ mi-cacao tsei lɛ miiho fɔfɔi bibii lɛ? Bulk dani afee cocoa pods?

english: A cocoa tree naturally blossoms with thousands of flowers, far more than it can feed. The tree intentionally sheds extra flowers it cannot support, though prolonged dry weather or insect attacks can cause even more flowers to fall.
ga: Cocoa tsei fɔ̃ɔ yɛ amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛhe kɛ fɔfɔi akpei abɔ. ni fe nɔ ni ebaanyɛ eye ebua Tso lɛ jwɛŋ ejie fɔfɔi krokomɛi ni enyɛŋ eye ebua. Eyɛ mli akɛ kɔɔyɔŋ ni mli egbi ni sɛɛ tsɛɔ loo kooloi ni baatutua amɛ lɛ baanyɛ aha fɔfɔi babaoo agbo moŋ, shi.

english: Why do my tomato flowers dry up and fall off without producing any fruit during the hot dry season?
ga: Mɛni hewɔ mi-tomato fɔfɔi lɛ gbɛ́ɔ ni amɛshwieɔ shi ni amɛwooo yibii yɛ hulutsoo be lɛ mli lɛ?

english: When afternoon temperatures get too high, heat damages the pollen inside tomato flowers so they cannot fertilize. Unfertilized flowers cannot produce tomatoes, so the plant sheds them.
ga: Kɛji hulutsoo be lɛ mli wa tsɔ yɛ shwane mli lɛ, hulutsoo be lɛ fiteɔ ŋmɔtɔ ni yɔɔ tomato fɔfɔi amli lɛ bɔni afee ni amɛnyɛŋ amɛwo fɔmɔ nii. Fɔfɔi ni awooo amɛ fɔ lɛ nyɛŋ awo tomato. No hewɔ lɛ tso lɛ gbee shi.

english: Why can my swamp rice grow well in flooded water, but my maize rots when water sits on the field?
ga: Mɛni hewɔ mi-swamp rice lɛ kwɛ̃ɔ jogbaŋŋ yɛ nu afua mli lɛ? Shi ani mi-ŋma lɛ fiteɔ kɛ́ nu yɛ ŋmɔ lɛ mli?

english: Rice stalks have special air tubes inside them that pump oxygen down to the roots under water. Maize roots lack these air channels, so they suffocate and rot if submerged in standing water for too long.
ga: Omɔ tsei lɛ yɛ kɔɔyɔɔ tsɔnei krɛdɛɛi komɛi yɛ amɛmli ni haa kɔɔyɔɔ kpakpa lɛ yaa shishifãi lɛ amli yɛ nu shishi. Abele shishifãi bɛ kɔɔyɔɔ kotokui. No hewɔ lɛ, kɛ́ akɛ amɛ wo nu ni ekã shi lɛ mli be kakadaŋŋ tsɔ lɛ, amɛmuɔ ni amɛgboiɔ.

english: Why do my maize plants easily fall over when strong winds blow during the rainy season?
ga: Mɛni hewɔ wɔ ŋmãa lɛ shwieɔ shi oya kɛ́ kɔɔyɔɔ ni naa wa miitswa yɛ nugbɔshiimɔ be lɛ mli lɛ?

english: Maize falls over when its root system is too shallow or weak to support its height. Planting seeds too shallowly or failing to heap soil around the base of the stems prevents prop roots from anchoring the plant firmly.
ga: Abele shwieɔ shi kɛ́ eshishifãi lɛ mli ekɔɔɔ tsɔ loo eyɛ bɔdɔɔ tsɔ ni enyɛŋ eye ebua elɛɛmɔ. Dumɔwui ni aduɔ yɛ he ko ni mli ekwɔɔɔ tsɔ loo ni anyɛɛɛ ato sũ ni abɔle tso lɛ shishi lɛ he lɛ baatsi shishifãi lɛ anaa koni amɛkafi tso lɛ sɛɛ jogbaŋŋ.

english: Curling leaves on pepper plants are usually caused by tiny insects like thrips or aphids sucking the sap from the underside of leaves, or by a virus carried by those insects that disrupts leaf growth.
ga: Bei pii lɛ, kooloi bibii tamɔ thrips loo aphids ni nuɔ nu ni jɛɔ baai lɛ ashishi lɛ ji nɔ ni kɛ baai lɛ shwieɔ shi yɛ pepper tsei lɛ anɔ. aloo kɛtsɔ helai ni nakai kooloi lɛ hiɛ ni tsiɔ baa lɛ naa lɛ nɔ

english: How can I tell if the soil on my land is good enough to support healthy cocoa trees?
ga: Te mafee tɛŋŋ male kɛji shikpɔŋ ni yɔɔ mishikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ hi bɔ ni sa ni baanyɛ akwɛ kookoo tsei ni yɔɔ hewalɛ anɔ?

english: Good cocoa soil is deep, dark, and well-drained. It should be rich in decaying organic leaves and able to hold moisture during dry spells without becoming waterlogged during heavy rains.
